jobs.title: On Call Resident Services Coordinator/ Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator (On-Call)** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator (On-Call)
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 0-39 hours per week
* **Job location:** Fremont CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00-$28.35

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

**Please Note**

*LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. Please provide us with notice if you will require accommodations during the interview process.*

jobs.title: Neuroscience Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professions education programs.

**Generic Scope** *(not customizable, will not be used in the job posting/advertisement)* **:**

Experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems / issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.

**Department Overview** *(please write a brief description of your department/unit that you would like to be included in the job posting/advertisement)*

The Graduate Medical Sciences Unit (GMU) provides centralized and highly specialized management of graduate and other training programs. This includes financial management, reporting an oversight for the Biomedical Sciences (BMS) Graduate Program, the Developmental Stem Cell Biology (DSCB) Graduate Program, the Neuroscience Graduate Program, the Medical Scientist Training Program (MSTP), the PROPEL Post-Baccalaureate Program and the CIRM Training Program. Because GMU staff focus exclusively on these training programs, they possess a unique level of expertise related to all aspects of graduate and other training programs.

  

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
* Minimum of 3 years of related experience
* Demonstrated experience and documented excellence in oral and written communications skills; includes active listening and critical thinking.
* Strong interpersonal skills. Actively cooperates and supports the work of others. Ability to work productively with anyone regardless of background. Empathetic and aware of impact on others. Strong problem solving skills to assist learners and resolve issues.
* Excellent organizational skills, analytical, and demonstrated attention to detail. Ability to complete work and meet established deadlines in an accurate and timely manner, and to manage short and competing deadlines.
* Thorough knowledge of educational software and platforms. Demonstrated ability to analyze and seek solutions to enhance the user experience.

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in related area preferred
* Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements. solid knowledge of health professions education program requirements. Thorough knowledge of health professions education industry
* Thorough knowledge of administrative analysis and operations research. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement processes and systems. Thorough knowledge of the administrative and operational implications in a program.
* Thorough knowledge of data management, documentation methods used in investigating and presenting findings about the program. Skills include statistical analysis of data across databases and systems.
* Experience supporting the academic progression of graduate students.
* Experience planning and coordinating academic courses and seminars.
* Experience working collaboratively with graduate program faculty.
* Knowledge of UCSF financial processes, policies, and procedures.

  

**About UCSF**

  

The University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) is a leading university dedicated to promoting health worldwide through advanced biomedical research, graduate-level education in the life sciences and health professions, and excellence in patient care. It is the only campus in the 10-campus UC system dedicated exclusively to the health sciences. We bring together the world’s leading experts in nearly every area of health. We are home to five Nobel laureates who have advanced the understanding of cancer, neurodegenerative diseases, aging and stem cells.

  
  

**Pride Values**

  

UCSF is a diverse community made of people with many skills and talents. We seek candidates whose work experience or community service has prepared them to contribute to our commitment to professionalism, respect, integrity, diversity and excellence – also known as our PRIDE values .

  

In addition to our PRIDE values, UCSF is committed to equity – both in how we deliver care as well as our workforce. We are committed to building a broadly diverse community, nurturing a culture that is welcoming and supportive, and engaging diverse ideas for the provision of culturally competent education, discovery, and patient care. Additional information about UCSF is available here .

  

Join us to find a rewarding career contributing to improving healthcare worldwide.

  
  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

  

The University of California is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or other protected status under state or federal law.

  
  

**Salary Information**

  

The final salary and offer components are subject to additional approvals based on UC policy.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator- Oakland, CA
jobs.description:
Cross Country is looking for top talent to join our team! We are a market-leading, tech-enabled workforce solutions and advisory firm with more than four decades of experience helping organizations solve complex labor and operational challenges. Recognized as a Top Place to Work by U.S. News & World Report and a Most Loved Workplace by Newsweek, Cross Country is committed to quality and excellence in everything we deliver. We were also the first public company to earn The Joint Commission Gold Seal of Approval® for Health Care Staffing Services Certification with Distinction — a standard we continue to uphold today.
  
  
**BASIC PURPOSE:**  
The Program Coordinator provides operational, administrative, and customer support to ensure the effective delivery of homecare services for PACE programs. This role focuses on supporting caregivers (HCPs), clients, and internal teams by managing onboarding/offboarding, compliance tracking, communication, and client relations. The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in ensuring caregivers are prepared and supported, client needs are met, and all processes remain compliant and efficient.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**  
1. Assist caregivers with onboarding, orientation, credentialing, and system access.
  
2. Provide ongoing support to field staff by addressing questions, resolving issues, and ensuring they have the resources needed for successful assignments.
  
3. Maintain accurate and current records of caregiver credentials, certifications, and licensures.
  
4. Communicate updates, policy changes, and assignment details clearly and promptly.
  
5. Support HCPs with timekeeping, payroll, and schedule confirmations.
  
1. Manage HCP timekeeping issues (e.g., missed punches, errors) and review timecards for processing to ensure accuracy and time corrections in a timely manager to avoid payment errors.
  
1. Serve as a primary contact for PACE program clients, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.
  
2. Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure service satisfaction.
  
3. Conduct periodic client satisfaction checks and follow up on feedback to improve service delivery.
  
4. Ensure client-specific requirements, policies, and procedures are accurately documented and shared with caregivers.
  
5. Work with Compliance team to ensure caregiver are compliant with all regulatory, licensing, and agency standards.
  
6. Maintain and update databases, internal systems, and client portals with accurate caregiver and client information.
  
7. Support audits by ensuring complete and accurate documentation is available when needed.
  
8. Generate, prepare, and distribute reports for internal teams and client review.
  
9. Assist with creating confirmation letters, client-facing communications, and process documentation.
  
10. Act as a liaison between caregivers, clients, and internal departments to ensure alignment and issue resolution.
  
11. Communicate clearly and consistently with all stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.
  
12. Provide backup coverage for colleagues to ensure uninterrupted clients and caregiver support.
  
13. Represent Cross Country Healthcare with professionalism and integrity in all interactions.
  
14. May be required to attend offsite job fairs and community events as needed.
  
15. May be required to provide after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage based on business needs, ensuring timely coordination of staffing and effective communication with PACE program partners to maintain continuity of care.
  
16. Other duties as assigned
  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS:**  
1. Minimum of one (1) year of administrative or client support experience, preferably in healthcare or staffing.
  
2. Strong organizational and time management skills with ability to handle multiple priorities.
  
3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  
5. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  
6. Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism in all situations.
  
7. Experience with VMS technology or client portals.
  
8. Bilingual skills preferred.
  
9. Strong problem-solving and relationship-building abilities.
  
**Education:** High School Diploma or equivalent required; Some college preferred.
  
  
Company equipment(laptop, monitor, keyboard, mouse headset) will be provided directly to you for use during employment.
  
  
Benefits
  
  
Cross Country offers a competitive compensation, benefits, and wellness program, including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Voluntary Insurance, 401(k) plan, Tuition Assistance, and Pet Insurance. The company offers a variety of Wellness options through Burnalong, which offers a robust online platform of classes and programs as well as local gym access.
  
  
Cross Country is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) - Veteran/Disability

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Program Coordinator is the primary administrative support for the local site. During recruitment, program coordinators manage incoming nominations, the interview schedule, and student personal information through Salesforce. Additionally, program coordinators provide logistical support for each phase of the interview process, as well as the Award Ceremony, and often take the lead in organizing volunteers. During Pre-Collegiate Training, program coordinators play a key role in managing the Writing Program and coordinate logistics for special events such as summer retreats and the Posse Olympics. In support of the Campus Program, program coordinators collect and organize student data and assist program directors in producing regular reports. Program Coordinators also manage travel logistics and supplies for special events on campus. In addition to these responsibilities, program coordinators provide general support for the local office such as managing calendars, tracking office supplies, answering phones, and welcoming students and guests. The program coordinator reports directly to the program director of the site.

* Bachelor’s Degree required
* Excellent writing skills
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to multi-task
* Excellent presentation and communication skills
* Excellent time-management skills
* Experience with youth is a plus
* Ability to work well with college students
* Able to work autonomously and within a team
* Event management experience a plus
* Proficiency required in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, internet and email
* Proficiency in Adobe InDesign and MS Access a plus
* Proficiency/Knowledge of Salesforce a plus
* Knowledge of design software
* Bilingual a plus
* Demonstrated belief in Posse’s mission and values

jobs.title: Aerial Arts Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About the role**

Los Gatos Elite's Aerial Arts program has a strong lead coach and a solid support staff. What we need now is someone to round out the team: a capable coach who also enjoys the organizational side of running a program.

Our aerial program includes:

* Recreational Aerial Silks
* Recreational Aerial Hoop/Lyra
* Competitive/Performance Hoop and Fabric

You'll coach across these levels and take ownership of the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the program running — scheduling, registrations, parent communication, and competition logistics — in partnership with our lead coach and LGE leadership.

**What your week looks like**

* **10–12 hours coaching** – recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes, plus support for competitive/performance team training
* **3–5 hours admin** – class rosters and scheduling, parent emails, competition registrations and entry fees, travel planning, showcase and event coordination
* **Travel for competitions** – accompany the team to aerial competitions and performances (dates shared in advance)

**Responsibilities**

* Coach recreational silks and hoop/lyra classes with safe, consistent progressions
* Assist the lead coach with competitive/performance training, conditioning, and act preparation
* Maintain the aerial class schedule, rosters, and enrollment records
* Serve as a primary point of contact for aerial families on schedules, fees, and competition details
* Manage competition registrations, entry fees, travel arrangements, and day-of logistics
* Coordinate with support coaches on coverage and class needs
* Follow and reinforce LGE's safety and rigging standards
* Represent LGE's culture of respect, growth, and teamwork with athletes, families, and staff

**What we're looking for**

* Solid experience in aerial silks/fabric and hoop/lyra as a coach and/or performer
* Experience coaching youth, from beginners through competitive/performance level
* Strong organizational and communication skills; comfortable with email, spreadsheets, and scheduling tools
* Someone who likes being the person who keeps things on track
* Working knowledge of aerial rigging and safety practices
* Available for competition travel, including some weekends
* Choreography or performance experience a plus
* Must pass and maintain a green light background check; CPR/First Aid certification (or willingness to obtain) required
* Must be able to stoop, bend, climb, and lift 50 pounds overhead

**Why LGE**

Los Gatos Elite is a gymnastics, ninja, and aerial training academy with a close-knit coaching team and a culture built on perpetual growth, respect, and teamwork. This is a role with real responsibility and a clear path to grow as the program does. Our aerialists perform in LGE's annual Showcase alongside our gymnastics and ninja athletes.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.company: Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco Inc.
jobs.title: Temporary Prevention Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
***Full-time, Temporary Position***

***Position Status:*** *This is a full-time, temporary position through December 31, 2026, with the potential for extension or transition to a permanent position based on program needs and funding availability. Extension or transition to permanent status is not guaranteed.*

Horizons Unlimited of San Francisco, Inc. (Horizons), established in 1965, is a community-based organization located in the Mission District and offers substance use prevention and early intervention, employment/workforce development, mental health and wellness, multimedia arts, and gender-affirming services, to Latine and all youth of color, up to age 24, and their families residing in the Mission District and throughout San Francisco.

Our programs help young people understand the systems that create inequality and how those systems affect their lives. We create safe spaces where they can make sense of their experiences, build healthy coping skills, and find their own power within these systems. Young people leave with the tools to take care of themselves and their communities and to create real change on their own terms.

**Position Title:** Principal Program Coordinator (Coordinator)

**Reports To**: Prevention Program Manager

**Program Description:** The Prevention Education Program is a comprehensive substance use prevention program that includes 3 core interventions: Communities Mobilizing for Change on Alcoholism (CMCA), Strengthening Families Program (SFP), Botvin LifeSkills Program (LST) and outreach activities.

**Position Description:** The Coordinator will be trained and responsible for facilitating groups for the 3 core interventions (CMCA, LST, SFP) according to the contract requirements and program needs. Key duties and responsibilities include outreach and recruitment, group facilitation, family engagement, data collection, reporting, etc. As part of the Prevention Team and work with the CMCA groups, the Coordinator will also participate in the COUN-SEL Coalition meetings and events as well as contribute broader prevention efforts as assigned.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop outreach materials and conduct outreach and recruitment for the Strengthening Families Program, with a focus on engaging African American/Black and Spanish-speaking families, as well as for Botvin LifeSkills, CMCA, and other Prevention services.
* Coordination of service provision for each intervention.
* Schedule, plan, and conduct participant orientations for admission and enrollment.
* Co-facilitate the Parent/Youth/Family components of the Strengthening Families program.
* Facilitate and lead Botvin Lifeskills program and CMCA cohorts onsite or at local school sites.
* Maintain youth files for all program participants, each cycle, as needed.
* Maintain detailed records of program attendance/services for reporting and submit monthly reports.
* Enter program services data into a tracking sheet within 24 hrs of activity.
* Reconcile data on a regular basis to ensure accuracy.
* Attend weekly program meetings, monthly All Staff meetings, and other meetings including funding source meetings.
* Maintain a programmatic budget.
* Implement program evaluations to measure the impact of delivery of services (i.e client satisfaction surveys, pre and post tests, etc.).
* Complete mandatory state compliance and other training.
* Support agency wide efforts which includes participation in 1-2 community wide committees/collectives that support the overall program mission and organizational values.
* Other duties assigned by the Prevention Program Manager.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree in social sciences or related field and/or 2+ years experience providing direct services for youth.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively facilitate youth groups.
* Commitment to learn environmental prevention work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet deadlines and juggle multiple competing deadlines/tasks in a fast paced environment.
* Able to maintain confidential, accurate, and complete records including documentation of daily attendance, hours tracking. monthly and quarterly reports, etc.
* Experience using Zoom, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Classroom, etc.), Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and other relevant software.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Job Requirements:**

* Must be able to work evenings, on weekends, and before normal business hours (10:00am-6:30pm or 12-8:30 on SFP Program evenings) for events, outreach, and training.
* Must clear a TB test before the first day of employment and annually.
* Commitment to complete all required annual training, including environmental prevention training.
* If in recovery, must be clean and sober for a minimum of 2 years.
* If the position becomes permanent, it will become subject to the SEIU Local 1021 Collective Bargaining Agreement, and the employee will be required to enroll in accordance with the applicable agreement.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* As a temporary position, this position is not eligible for Horizons’ health, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits, except for benefits required by applicable law.
* **If the position becomes permanent, the employee will become eligible for Horizons’ benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, and AD&D insurance, effective on the first of the month following one full month of continuous employment, as well as paid vacation, sick leave, holidays, and professional development opportunities, subject to applicable eligibility requirements.**
* Hourly wages range from $28.37 to $29.22.

Date Posted: **October 8, 2026**

Application Deadline: **Open Until Filled.**

jobs.description:
**Build What Matters Most—Families, Futures, and Your Career**

Enjoy meaningful work while contributing to an organization that changes lives every day. **US Fertility**, the nation’s leading partnership of physician-led fertility practices, is redefining what it means to build a career in reproductive medicine.

Our team members choose to build their career home at US Fertility because of the **hope we inspire in our patients**, the **lives we help bring into the world**, and the **culture of excellence we foster across our organization.** We share a deep commitment to continuously improving the patient experience and advancing research and development in one of the most dynamic and impactful fields of medicine.

Through our national network of premier fertility centers—including **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area**—we combine clinical expertise, scientific innovation, and compassionate care. The work we do building families offers purpose, challenge, and personal reward—and we’re just getting started.

**Opportunity Overview**

We have an immediate opening for a **Patient Navigator** to join our team at **Reproductive Science Center of the San Francisco Bay Area** in **Menlo Park, California.**

* **Schedule:**Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, one weekend per month and two to three holidays per year
* **Compensation:**$35 to $43 per hour (commensurate with experience)

This role provides the opportunity to grow within a nationally respected organization while remaining closely connected to the patients and teams you support every day.  
  
**How You’ll Contribute**

At US Fertility, collaboration is fundamental to how we work. There is undeniable strength in numbers—and support is always within reach. Whether collaborating with more than **200 highly respected physicians nationwide** or partnering with colleagues who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, you’ll be surrounded by a team committed to shared success.

In this role, the **Patient Navigator** will:

* Meet with established patients and assists with coordination of pretreatment requirements in conjunction with physician orders
* Provide patient education regarding clarification of physician instructions, medication instruction, and anticipatory guidance under the supervision of the RN
* Establish a compassionate environment by providing excellent customer service, anticipating anxieties, answering questions, providing support
* Assure quality care by adhering to Practice standards; follows clinical operations policies and procedures, as well as standards of care set by the state and other governing agency regulations
* Documents patient care services by charting in patient and department records including the electronic medical record (EMR)
* Utilize the computer in entering labs and printing labels
* Maintain safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations, and calling for assistance from other health care support if needed
* Scan forms, records, and other information as needed into the EMR
* Be responsible for generating and maintaining patient pretreatment requirements in conjunction with clinical protocols
* Communicate with financial coordinator to ensure authorizations obtained prior to starting treatment; Assist with completing and routing needed insurance forms (i.e., insurance questionnaires); Send results to financial coordinator and/or insurance plan as needed
* Utilize scheduling system for purposes of managing the primary physician’s schedule and scheduling patients for the primary physician
* Communicate problems to the primary clinical team, i.e. pretreatment or financial concerns
* Review patient records for completion of prescreening inclusive of medical history, appropriate laboratory work, and informed consent
* Check that consents are current and entered into the EMR; Inform patient/couple of consents needing to be updated
* Assist in obtaining authorizations for medications; Communicates with insurance plans and pharmacies to ensure patient able to obtain medications in timely manner
* Document laboratory results in the EMR checklists after review the by RN and/or physician
* Document delivery data in the EMR; Review lists for team’s patients needing delivery data entry and notifies RN/assists RN with collection
* Prepare patient information packets, as needed
* Assist team with correspondence and other administrative tasks, as needed
* Contribute to the upkeep of office equipment and daily “operational” functions within the office. (i.e. fax, printer, mail, filing, coping)

**What You’ll Bring**

We’re looking for professionals who bring both technical skill and a deep sense of responsibility to the care experience—individuals who thrive in environments where excellence, empathy, and accountability matter.

**Qualifications and Skills Include:**

* High school diploma required; 1 year experience in medical or healthcare setting (women’s health experience a plus)
* Medical or clinical training (MA, LVN) preferred. If LVN, current state LVN license without limitations required
* Patient Navigator with MA or LPN responsibilities: Current CPR certification or CPR Certification acquired within 1 month of employment
* Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer
* Knowledge of office procedure and office machines (i.e. computer, fax, copier, etc.)
* Ability to demonstrate good judgment, critical thinking, and problem solving abilities
* Ability to function as a member of a multi-disciplinary healthcare team
* Ability to communicate accurately and concisely
* Excellent interpersonal skills and patient orientation
* Ability to work independently to manage a caseload of patients

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.
* Experience in support operations, driving B2B or B2C growth, ad-tech industry, or consulting.
* Experience with data analysis, data analytics, quantitative analysis.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of the creator ecosystem and support operations best practices.
* Ability to analyze results to identify trends and identify opportunities to drive improvements in user facing outcomes.
* Ability to effectively influence, communicate and drive change with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of management.
* Strong leadership, communication, and people skills.
* Proven track record of developing and implementing successful user support strategies and influencing product solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Exceptional business judgment to drive continuous improvement and own project end-to-end.

------------

Intuit’s Mid-Market organization is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Generation Analyst to drive deep insights across the demand generation funnel. This role will be responsible for analyzing performance from first touch through lead routing and handoff, identifying leakage, uncovering trends, and ensuring every lead is properly tracked, routed, and acted upon. **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Business, Economics, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

jobs.title: Sr Mgr, Product Operations, Alexa Tablet Product Operations
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

As a Senior Manager, Product Operations, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive, design and develop innovative consumer products.
  
  
The person will lead a team responsible for defining and committing to the operations plan for delivery of innovative consumer products within Alexa Tablets Product Operations. In this role, you will operate at the earliest and most influential stage of the Product Development Process (PDP), the pre-concept phase, where you will combine the expertise of a business ownership, commodity expertise, product technical needs. You will be the operations authority that shapes product Roadmap for Alexa Tablet devices when decisions matter most, influencing critical choices before designs crystallize and features are locked. You must demonstrate leadership in a cross-functional, matrixed environment and able to succeed within an open, collaborative, peer environment.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Leading a team of high-impact professionals to define future products based on customer needs and viability

  

* Decomposing product concepts into component and manufacturing drivers using industry benchmarks and deep supply chain knowledge

  

* Influencing executive management on design decisions through dive deep into assumptions, communicating complex tradeoffs with clarity and confidence

  

* Facilitating decision-making conversations with Product Management, Engineering, and Supply Chain that balance product feature requirements, development timeline, and cost considerations

  

* Building and implementing methodology to enable high-fidelity analysis for product tradeoffs in early concept phase

  

* Providing guidance and support to both OPMs and MPMs to ensure cohesive supply chain strategies across Tablet Product Line

  

* Problem solve and explore solutions to current processes and systems

  

* Coordinate with cross functional teams throughout development and manufacturing

  

* Drive continuous improvements

  

* This role will require international travel

  
A day in the life  
As Sr. Manager, Tablet Product Ops, you will lead a small team of highly skilled operations professionals to define the next product concepts. You will spend significant time in collaborative sessions with product managers and engineers, framing complex tradeoffs between customer experience, technical performance, development timelines, and cost. You will proactively guide teams toward viable directions in the ambiguity of pre-concept development. Your afternoons might include assessing strategic recommendations, or diving deep into manufacturing requirements to assess feasibility of novel approaches.  
  
About the team  
Our Tablet Product Operations organization drives innovation in consumer electronics, bringing exciting products from concept to customer hands. The early-stage costing function sits at a critical juncture—where strategic decisions have maximum leverage but information is most uncertain. Our team values analytical rigor combined with practical judgment, collaborative problem-solving, and the courage to influence difficult decisions. You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and supply chain professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences at sustainable costs.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of program management, tech program management, or related experience
* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
* Comprehensive knowledge of consumer electronics supply chain from component sourcing through manufacturing and fulfillment

----------------------------

* Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
* Experience working directly with designers and technical subject matter experts
* Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
* 12+ years of experience in operations or commodity management roles
* Experience with multiple manufacturing processes (injection molding, die casting, PCB assembly, final assembly, etc.)
* Experience facilitating executive decision-making on complex product tradeoffs

**CIRCE Technology & Research, Business Development**

Ensures compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards, supports clinical education and patient care activities, and promotes operational excellence through quality improvement, staff development, and effective resource management.

* Infection control protocols, standards, and regulatory requirements.

**Ability to:**

* Produce professional reports and correspondence.
* Utilize Microsoft 365 applications for reporting, presentations, communication, and data analysis.

jobs.title: Deputy Program Manager for Security & Protection - Active Clearance Required
jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Deputy Program Manager** (DPM) for the Security and Protection (S&P) Program within the Security Organization (SO). The S&P DPM is responsible for general oversight and personnel management of all S&P sections; in research and development (R&D), manufacturing, quality and assurance (QA), order compliance, systems and equipment distribution, as well as viability and operations in support of high-end security systems and associated technologies. In this position you will manage a multi-disciplinary team of scientists, software programmers, engineering/ technical staff, quality assurance, and administrative personnel, while being responsible for all areas of program management, high-level goal setting, and the development of strategies.

You will be responsible for assisting with the execution of the program’s annual operating plan (AOP) to meet objectives and deliverables by the NNSA Office of Defense Nuclear Security (NA-70), as well as Strategic Partnership Programs. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division (NSED) within the Engineering Directorate.

*Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid work arrangement, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

**You will**

* Provide leadership and technical oversight to the multi-disciplinary team including matrixed full-time employees (FTE’s) from directorates throughout the laboratory, as well as contractors.
* Manage cross-sectional (Software Development, IT Management, Systems Engineering, and Enterprise Communications) projects and logistical workflow.
* Provide leadership and managerial oversight S&P’s Annual Operating Plan (AOP), including the allocation, monitoring of available personnel, and a ~$30M-$40M dollar budget.
* Provide oversight and guidance of S&P’s annual operating budget and effort.
* Lead recruiting, hiring, mentoring and the development of high-quality staff to support program sections and assist in their professional growth and advancement in technical and security areas.
* Participate in NA-70/713 enterprise collaborative meetings and ensure S&P’s scope of work is clearly defined and advocate for and support development of appropriately funded scope. Effectively interface with other national laboratories and industry partners as part of the collaboration team.
* Establish relationships with Department of Energy (DOE) enterprise sites security managers, system owners, personnel, and federal office personnel, including the Livermore Local Field Office (LFO).
* Develop Work for Others (WFO's) proposals for the development of new security technologies.
* Travel to DOE enterprise and industry partner sites in support of S&P projects, NA-70/713 discussions, DOE enterprise site visits, and industry partner meetings.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the SEL.5 level**

* Develop strategic initiatives to ensure the ongoing success of the whole enterprise consisting of seven (7) sites throughout the country, while creating a roadmap of future enterprise initiatives in collaboration with all stakeholders. Brief work to senior management on overall impact and approach.
* Cultivate relationships with NNSA sponsors and technology leaders, while providing technical input and developing or refining new concepts in support of nuclear security priorities that promote LLNL skills, expertise, and technologies.
* Cultivate and build relationships with other potential customers across the DOE, and Work for Others (WFO) (i.e., Department of Defense (DoD), and others) looking for additional program sponsors for new business opportunities.

### **Qualifications**

* This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Nuclear Security or related discipline, or the equivalent combination of education and extensive related experience.
* Significant experience solving complex system engineering problems in physical security systems or industrial control systems, intrusion detection systems, with in-depth experience in specialized areas.
* Ability to motivate and collaborate effectively with other personnel in achieving project objectives.
* Expert level experience leading complex programs and a proven record of resolving program management issues, as well as negotiating statements of work, timelines, and deliverables.
* Expert level experience leading, tracking, and budgeting projects that require the application of creative innovation in managing and resource conflict resolution.
* Ability to delegate effectively to accomplish goals within a multi-disciplinary team through leadership and positive influence, providing corrective measures when necessary.
* Experience working with sponsors/government agencies, such as, NNSA, DOE, Department of Homeland Security (DHS), DOD, or other government agencies.

The ideal candidate blends operational, strategic, analytical, and collaboration skills with a track record of taking ideas from vision to execution. They bring strong program management expertise, sound decision quality, and effective two-way communication to align cross-functional stakeholders, drive goals and strategies, and navigate tradeoffs. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with ambiguity, this person embraces change and acts as a steward of the Nordstrom brand – driving growth and taking ownership of end-to-end quality for what's deployed across our network.

* Identification and escalation of issues: Identify and capture issues/risks and ensure appropriate information is captured to size the impact and determine next steps for resolution.
* Insights & Analysis: Gather, interpret, and analyze data to inform decision making that supports program delivery.
* Ensure all program and project milestones are being met and appropriately raise concerns where there is potential impact to the program scope, timeline, or budget.

**Job Title:** Project Manager III  
**Location:** Oakland, CA  
**Duration:** November 2, 2026– June 26, 2027

**Account Manager Notes:**  
Local candidates only, will be remote and onsite as needed. Can set expectation of one day onsite per week  
Senior IT Project Manager – Tanium Program

**Job Description:**  
**Position Summary**  
The Senior IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of Tanium. This role oversees project scope, schedule, budget, resources, vendor engagement, risk management, and stakeholder communications to ensure the successful implementation of Tanium capabilities, including configuration drift management, endpoint management, patching, asset discovery, compliance monitoring, and migration from legacy solutions.  
The successful candidate will serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure operations, application teams, architects, and vendor partners to deliver strategic outcomes that improve operational efficiency, security posture, and regulatory compliance.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Program & Project Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Tanium projects and workstreams.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and resource forecasts.
* Manage multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
* Establish project governance, controls, reporting mechanisms, and escalation paths.
* Facilitate steering committee, status, and stakeholder meetings.

**Scope, Schedule & Financial Management**

* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, and success metrics.
* Manage project budgets, forecasts, labor plans, vendor expenditures, and financial reporting.
* Coordinate project funding approvals and governance reviews.
* Monitor project performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
* Ensure delivery within approved scope, schedule, and budget constraints.

**Tanium Deployment & Modernization**

* **Coordinate deployment, configuration, and optimization of Tanium platform modules.**
* **Support migration from legacy tools and processes to Tanium capabilities.**
* Manage implementation activities across the enterprise.
* Coordinate endpoint onboarding, testing, validation, and production rollout activities.
* Work with technical teams to establish deployment standards and operational procedures.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary engagement lead for Tanium vendors, consultants, and professional services partners.
* Manage Statements of Work (SOWs), contracts, deliverables, and vendor performance.
* Coordinate across infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, compliance, operations, and business teams.
* Provide executive-level status updates and project communications.
* Build strong relationships with technical and business stakeholders to achieve project objectives.

**Risk, Compliance & Quality Management**

* Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues.
* Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, audit, SOX, NERC, and organizational requirements.
* Develop mitigation plans for schedule, budget, and technical challenges.
* Track dependencies impacting project delivery and operational readiness.
* Drive quality assurance activities and project acceptance processes.

**Reporting & Communications**

* Develop executive dashboards, KPIs, metrics, and status reports.
* Present project health, milestones, risks, and accomplishments to senior leadership.
* Maintain project documentation, decision logs, RAID logs, and operational transition plans.
* Provide consolidated reporting on deployment status, project progress, and business outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 8+ years of IT project or program management experience.
* 5+ years managing large-scale infrastructure, cybersecurity, or enterprise software implementations.
* Demonstrated experience managing enterprise endpoint management or security platform deployments.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* Experience managing budgets exceeding $500,000 and coordinating cross-functional teams.
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Project, Planisware, Jira, or similar project management tools.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing or managing Tanium platform deployments.
* Experience with cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, endpoint security, or IT asset management.
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, NERC-CIP, PCI, or similar compliance requirements.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent certification.
* Experience leading cloud, infrastructure modernization, and operating system lifecycle programs.
* Utility industry or critical infrastructure experience preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic Planning
* Program Governance
* Executive Communication
* Vendor Management
* Financial Management
* Risk & Issue Management
* Change Management
* Infrastructure & Operations Management
* Cybersecurity Program Delivery
* Cross-Functional Leadership
* Continuous Improvement
* Stakeholder Engagement

**Success Measures**  
**The Senior IT Project Manager will be measured on:**

* Successful delivery of Tanium project milestones.
* Achievement of schedule, budget, and scope objectives.
* Endpoint deployment and adoption targets.
* Compliance and audit readiness outcomes.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and executive reporting quality.
* Reduction of operational and security risks.
* Successful transition of project deliverables into steady-state operations.

jobs.description:
Kitchen Project Manager & Designer

**Company:** Berkeley Mills  
**Location:** Berkeley, CA  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Salary:** $90,000–$115,000 per year, depending on experience (DOE)

About Berkeley Mills

Berkeley Mills is a premier custom furniture and cabinetry manufacturer located in Berkeley, California. We specialize in designing and manufacturing exceptional kitchens, custom cabinetry, and fine furniture, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern design and manufacturing technology.

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented **Kitchen Project Manager & Designer** to join our team. This position combines kitchen design, technical drafting, and project management, working closely with clients, architects, interior designers, engineers, and our in-house manufacturing team.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in kitchen and cabinetry design, proficiency in CAD software, and the ability to independently produce accurate design drawings. Experience preparing detailed cabinetry shop drawings is a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities: Kitchen Design & CAD Drafting

* Develop detailed kitchen layouts, floor plans, elevations, and design drawings using CAD software.
* Translate client requirements, architectural plans, and design concepts into accurate, functional kitchen designs.
* Independently produce professional design drawings for client presentations, design approvals, and production coordination.
* Review and refine cabinetry layouts, dimensions, materials, finishes, and hardware specifications.
* Ensure kitchen designs meet functional, aesthetic, and dimensional requirements.
* Coordinate with our engineering and manufacturing teams to ensure designs are practical, accurate, and ready for production.
* Prepare or assist with technical shop drawings and manufacturing documentation when needed.
* Incorporate design revisions and maintain accurate, organized drawing sets throughout each project.

Project Management

* Manage custom kitchen and cabinetry projects from initial design through manufacturing and installation.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, architects, interior designers, and other project stakeholders.
* Coordinate project schedules, design approvals, material selections, and production requirements.
* Work closely with the engineering and manufacturing departments to ensure project specifications are clearly communicated.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential issues, and maintain established timelines.
* Coordinate site measurements, field verification, and installation requirements.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.
* Ensure completed projects meet Berkeley Mills' standards for craftsmanship, design, and quality.

Required Qualifications

* Professional experience in kitchen design, custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, or a closely related field.
* **Proficiency in CAD software and the demonstrated ability to independently produce accurate design drawings.**
* Ability to create detailed kitchen floor plans, elevations, and cabinetry layouts.
* Strong understanding of kitchen planning, cabinetry dimensions, and residential design principles.
* Experience managing projects, coordinating schedules, and communicating with clients and project stakeholders.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, construction documents, and specifications.
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* **Experience producing detailed cabinetry shop drawings and manufacturing drawings is a significant plus.**
* Experience designing high-end residential kitchens and custom cabinetry.
* Familiarity with AutoCAD, Microvellum, SolidWorks, or comparable design and drafting software.
* Understanding of cabinetry construction methods, joinery, hardware, and manufacturing processes.
* Experience working directly with cabinetmakers, engineers, CNC operators, or production teams.
* Familiarity with premium cabinetry materials, hardware, and finishes.
* Experience conducting field measurements and coordinating cabinetry installations.
* Background in architectural millwork, interior architecture, or residential construction.

Compensation & Benefits

**Annual Salary: $90,000–$115,000 DOE**

Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, technical proficiency, design capabilities, and project management background.

Benefits include:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off (PTO)
* Paid sick leave

Department Overview
  
  
Welcome to Electric Asset Strategy (EAS). We are responsible for asset strategy, standards, procedures, and end-to-end risk management for 2.3 million structures across the electric distribution system. We deliver risk-informed strategic plans that leverage inspection insights and asset data to guide maintenance and investment decisions.
  
  
The Distribution Asset Risk Management (ARM) team—comprising Asset Failure Analysis (AFA), Asset Insights, and Inspections & Maintenance Strategy (I&M)—focuses on continuously improving how PG&E monitors and maintains its assets to support a resilient, reliable grid and help keep our communities safe.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Manager, Expert will lead the development, implementation, and financial stewardship of I&M strategy programs for PG&E’s electric distribution assets. The role will translate regulatory requirements, asset condition insights, risk analysis, budget planning, accounting considerations, and operational constraints into executable multiyear strategies and work plans that improve safety, reliability, compliance, affordability, and risk-spend efficiency.
  
  
This position requires strong accounting, financial analysis, investment planning, and practical AI literacy to develop defensible budgets, forecasts, business cases, and funding recommendations. The successful candidate will play a leading role in Business Plan Deployment (BPD); annual and multiyear investment planning; cost and variance analysis; prioritization of competing capital and expense needs; and reconciliation of program scope, unit costs, work volumes, and financial outcomes. The role will use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate research and synthesis, analyze structured and unstructured information, test assumptions, draft and quality-check work products, and improve the speed and consistency of financial, regulatory, and program management activities. The successful candidate will apply sound judgment, protect confidential information, validate outputs against authoritative sources, and maintain clear human accountability. The role will establish performance measures, monitor program and financial results, challenge assumptions, and present clear recommendations to senior leaders and governance forums.
  
  
The Program Manager, Expert will also provide critical regulatory support and may serve as a General Rate Case (GRC) witness assistant, helping coordinate the development of accurate, consistent, and well-supported testimony, workpapers, exhibits, and discovery responses. The role will lead cross-functional responses to regulatory data requests—often on short notice—by rapidly organizing subject-matter experts, validating operational and financial data, documenting assumptions and source support, identifying risks and inconsistencies, and delivering high-quality responses within firm deadlines. Strong partnerships across Asset Strategy, Inspections, Maintenance, Operations, Engineering, Wildfire Risk, Regulatory, Compliance, Finance, Accounting, Law, Technology, data teams, vendors, and external partners will be essential to meeting program and regulatory commitments.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company, in good faith, believes it might pay for this position at the time of posting. This compensation range is specific to the job’s location. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, collective bargaining agreements, and internal equity. Although we estimate that the successful candidate will be placed near the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis based on these factors.

**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

VahatiCor is a venture-backed medical technology company developing a new cardiovascular therapy. As the company grows beyond its startup incubator, it is building the quality systems and infrastructure needed to support its next stage.

POSITION OVERVIEW

As a member of the Quality Department, the Quality Assurance Manager will oversee a team of inspectors and quality engineers. The Manager will support the Quality Management System (QMS) by ensuring processes are documented, updating top management on the effectiveness of the QMS and areas for improvement, and promoting quality policies throughout the organization.

The Manager will partner with R&D and Regulatory teams to ensure procedures are compliant and accurately documented for regulatory submissions.

This is a hands-on management role supporting VahatiCor's Class III catheter-based cardiovascular technologies, with particular emphasis on design controls, product development, risk management, manufacturing quality, design transfer, and regulatory inspection readiness.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Quality Management System (QMS)

* Support the QMS Management Representative by:
* + Ensuring processes needed for the quality management system are documented.
  + Reporting to top management on the effectiveness of the QMS and any need for improvement.
  + Ensuring the promotion and awareness of applicable regulatory and QMS requirements throughout the organization.
* Collaborate with departmental leaders to maintain quality procedures supporting VahatiCor's product development, manufacturing, and regulatory activities.
* Participate in management review activities and track identified quality system improvement actions.

jobs.description:
Supporting Community Healthcare is a rewarding role, come join a wonderful organization! LifeLong Medical Care is looking for a **Patient Services Representative** (PSR) to join our Call Center team in Berkeley. The PSR serve as front-line phone staff and “navigators” for our patients, their caregivers and other healthcare entities in our busy Patient Services Call Center. Answer incoming calls, register patients and schedule appointments, triage calls to different departments including urgent calls, document and task messages and other notes in patients’ Electronic Health Record (EHR). Perform other Patient Services Department duties as needed.

This is a full time, 40 hours/week, benefit eligible position. Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

*LifeLong Medical Care is a multi-site, Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) with a rich history of providing innovative healthcare and social services to a wonderfully diverse patient community. We have over 15 primary care health centers and deliver integrated services including psychosocial, referrals, chronic disease management, dental, health education, home visits, and much, much more.*

*Compensation: $22/hour. We offer excellent benefits including: medical, dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous leave benefits including ten paid holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) retirement savings plan.*

* Excellent customer service skills using a positive, proactive, “can-do” approach.
* Ability to work effectively and calmly under pressure in a positive, friendly manner.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and juggle multiple tasks.
* Strong problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change.
* Ability to work in a team-oriented environment with staff with different work and communication styles.

***Job Requirements***

* One (1) year of multi-line telephone experience and/or one (1) year experience as medical receptionist with scheduling and telephone experience.

***Job Preferences***

* At least one-year of experience in a healthcare setting preferred including experience in private practice, or a Community Health Center.
* Bilingual English/Spanish highly preferred.

ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has been dedicated to preventing and resolving homelessness and improving the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**CURRENT OPENING:**

**Supported Employment Program Manager**

**Full-time (40 Hours), Exempt**

**Annual Pay: $80,000-95,000**

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a **Supported Employment Program Manager** to join our Senior Leadership Team. This full-time, exempt position reports to the CEO and is based in San Rafael, CA

**Position Description:**

The Supported Employment Program Manager provides oversight to Ritter Center’s Individual Placement and Support (IPS) program, a model of supported employment for people with serious mental illness. This role works closely with and expands our partnership with the County of Marin’s Behavioral Health and Recovery Services (BHRS) division.

The Program Manager will ensure high fidelity to the IPS evidence-based practice and positive client outcomes by providing training, supervision, and working side-by-side with Employment Specialists (field mentoring). They will monitor outcomes and implement quality improvement plans for individuals served while also acting as a liaison to other departments and agencies. This role supervises the Employment Specialists and Benefits Specialist and provides direct supported employment services initially and ongoing as needed.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* Works in partnership with BHRS and the California IPS Center of Excellence to arrange for IPS Training and fidelity reviews. Assists with the development of fidelity action plans based on recommendations from the fidelity report.
* Hires, trains, and evaluates staff. Develops expectations for specialists regarding employer contacts, number of job starts each quarter, and employment rate (percentage of people employed on each caseload).
* Assigns each employment specialist to Marin County BHRS Full Service teams.
* Attends each BHRS treatment team meeting monthly, or more often as needed, to enhance integrated services.
* Conducts weekly group supervision following the principles of IPS supported employment.
* Oversees program documentation and ensures compliance with BHRS clinical documentation standards, SmartCare requirements, Medi-Cal billing requirements, and quality assurance expectations.
* Monitors contract performance measures, service utilization, employment outcomes, fidelity benchmarks, and quality improvement indicators to ensure compliance with County and State requirements
* Serves as primary lead for IPS fidelity reviews, corrective action plans, implementation monitoring, and coordination with the California IPS Center of Excellence.
* Ensures compliance with DHCS, Medi-Cal, HIPAA, BHRS, CalAIM, Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), and applicable federal, state, and county requirements.
* Prepares for and participates in county, state, federal, and fidelity audits, monitoring visits, corrective action processes, and reporting reviews.
* Provides individual supervision for employment specialists. Supervision includes some office-based sessions, as well working side-by-side with specialists.
* Collects client outcomes monthly. Shares outcomes for the program, as well as individual practitioners, with the supported employment team each quarter.
* Helps team members set goals, review individual outcomes, and develop written plans to refine skills and improve outcomes.
* Acts as a liaison to other department coordinators and administrators in the organization.
* Communicates regularly with mental health supervisors to ensure that services are integrated, to resolve issues, and to act as a proponent for employment.
* Works with the division of BHRS to coordinate services. Coordinates monthly meetings between team members to discuss how to help people served by both agencies.
* Leads or participates in steering committee meetings to help with IPS supported employment implementation and sustainability.
* Provides supported employment services when the team needs additional support.
* Verifies/approves bi-weekly staff timesheets.
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in behavioral health, rehabilitation, counseling, social work, psychology, public health, or a related field. Equivalent years’ experience can be substituted for education requirement.
* Previous supported employment experience and/or community job placement services
* Previous experience in the behavioral health field
* Previous supervisory experience
* Must have a valid CA driver’s license and satisfactory driving record

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree and/or professional licensure (LCSW, LPCC, LMFT, Psychologist, CRC, or equivalent)
* Experience with IPS programs or other supported employment programs serving people with serious mental illness

**About the Role**
------------------

Tavus customers are building products and experiences with conversational AI. Getting from a signed contract to a successful deployment takes more than access to the platform. Customers need clear priorities, a workable implementation plan, and a partner who understands what they are trying to accomplish.

You will report to our Customer Lead and take ownership of an existing portfolio of customers, helping them move through implementation, adoption, and renewal. You will run the day-to-day relationship, coordinate technical partners, and keep customer commitments moving.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful independence. Your portfolio will include ongoing implementations and established customers between renewal cycles. You will inherit unfinished work, build trust with customers, and establish a clear plan for what happens next.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Own your portfolio.** Build relationships with the people using, implementing, and buying Tavus. Understand their business objectives, success criteria, decision process, and reasons to renew.
* **Turn customer goals into working plans.** Establish milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision dates. For new customers, work with Sales and Customer Engineering to carry the buying context and agreed scope into onboarding. For existing customers, reconstruct missing context and reset the plan where needed.
* **Run dependable customer communication.** Acknowledge requests, clarify their impact, secure the right internal owner, and set the next update. Keep customers informed when answers or delivery dates change, without requiring them to chase.
* **Drive adoption and customer value.** Identify stalled implementations, weak engagement, and unrealized use cases. Determine whether the constraint is product quality, implementation, customer capacity, sponsorship, or fit, and coordinate a practical intervention.

When a request lacks an owner, a credible delivery plan, or an agreed scope, you escalate with the customer impact, options, and decision needed. You are comfortable setting expectations and explaining tradeoffs without promising work another team has not committed to deliver.

You will run routine account decisions independently within agreed priorities and commercial guidelines. Strategic escalations, pricing exceptions, and commitments beyond existing scope are handled with the Customer Lead and the relevant functional owner.

jobs.description:
**BENEFITS CASE MANAGER**

**The Center for Elders’ Independence (CEI)** provides a Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (P.A.C.E.) - a comprehensive healthcare model specifically designed for low-income, frail seniors. It combines medical and social services along with vigilant care planning and coordination in order to keep frail seniors safely living at home and in their communities. This unique and highly effective model utilizes an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning to drive high quality, affordable, integrated healthcare services to the elderly.

**Position****:** Under the supervision of Director of Enrollment and Member Services, the Benefits Case Manager ensures that all CEI participants are enrolled in all income and insurance benefits that they are eligible for. Benefits Case Manager will be required to work effectively with participants, participant families, representative payees and relevant government agencies to proactively maintain and address benefit eligibility issues that arise as well as support different prospect/participant benefit related projects within the agency.

The hourly pay range for the Benefits Case Manager position at Center for Elders’ Independence is $26.25 to $39.38. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI’s annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Department and Caseload Management**

* Benefits Case Manager keeps track and ensures that all participants’ benefits eligibility needs are met; this includes working directly with the participants, participant families, representative payees and the relevant government agencies to proactively maintain benefit eligibility and resolve all eligibility issues that arise.
* Manages the assigned participant eligibility caseload which includes attending enrollment, care conference meetings and conducting home visits with participants where eligibility issues need to be addressed.
* Manages the caseload information on participants in a well-organized and secure filing system as devised by the department.
* Keeps track and monitors the eligibility status of the participant assigned to the caseload and generates regular reports as needed.

**Income Benefits**

* Ensures that the CEI participants’ income information assigned to the caseload is known and verified at all times and is well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that accurate share-of-cost information is gathered, well documented and communicated with the participant on the caseload and the finance staff in an effective and in a timely fashion to enable CEI to collect share-of-cost revenue.
* Works with the participants, families and social workers connected to the assigned caseload to ensure that the Board and Care and SNF income level changes are made by the social security administration, that all involved understand the changes and that the benefit levels are accurate on all Board and Care documents.
* Communicates income issues to social work, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to ensure interdepartmental effectiveness.

**Insurance Benefits**

* Ensures that all CEI participants’ benefit information on the assigned caseload is known and verified at all times and well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that CEI participants who are assigned to the caseload are fully enrolled in Medi-Cal and any Medicare benefits they are eligible for prior to enrollment and following enrollment (ie assist with getting participants who are Medi-Cal only qualify for Medicare and participant missing Medicare Part A qualified for QMB benefit to obtain Part A coverage).
* Manages Medi-Cal re-certification to ensure that eligibility is maintained for all participants and facilitate proper communication and documents if retro payment request needs to be processed for month reflecting no payment code.
* Verify IHSS enrollment information prior to enrollment and document in CEI database for proper termination after enrollment.
* Communicates insurance issues to social worker, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to sure interdepartmental effectiveness.

**Relevant Skills and Experience:**

* High School diploma required.
* Experience or knowledge in benefit such as Medi-Cal, Medicare and other common benefits available for seniors.
* Excellent customer service and service recovery skills.
* Strong case management skills. Ability to work closely with cross-functional team members including Outreach and Enrollment staff and IDT staff at the PACE centers.
* A demonstrated history of success in goal attainment.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both oral and written.
* Must be proficient with computer applications including spreadsheets, word processing and Customer Relationship Management (Salesforce).
* Excellent decision-making ability, customer service and negotiation.
* Possess the capacity to work in a high-stressed, high paced environment while maintaining a positive attitude.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Bilingual preferred: English/Spanish; English / Cantonese or Mandarin Chinese; English / Vietnamese or other.
* A passion for working with the senior and underserved populations.

**Physical and Travel Requirements:**

* Ability to sit, stand, stoop, reach, lift (up to 40 pounds), bend, etc.; hand and wrist dexterity to utilize keyboard.
* Travel within assigned territory and agency sites and programs.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation and insurance coverage required.

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations.
