We are looking for Operations Managers to be located in multiple locations in the US such as Miami (FL), Austin (TX), Atlanta (GA), etc.

The role will report to our General Manager for North America.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Logistics: Coordinate and optimize logistics for installations and operations across the US, and at times globally, in line with HQ guidelines.
* Procurement & Cost Control: Ensure cost-effective procurement and management of equipment and resources.
* Installations: Own the planning and execution of AI camera installations.
* Support: Advise and support our international offices on technology choices and technical issues.
* Partner & Stakeholder Relations: Manage relationships with sports federations, leagues, event organizers, venue owners, suppliers, and other key stakeholders to support successful installations, smooth operations, and long-term partnerships.
* Software Integrations: Coordinate and oversee integrations with third-party software providers, including electronic scoresheets, scoring systems, and other external platforms, ensuring compatibility and reliable operational performance.
* Overall Operations: Liaise with our support centers which handles monitoring and status reporting on operational performance, and help ensure reporting standards set by HQ are followed.
* AI Quality: Evaluate and ensure AI performance for existing and new sports.
* Research & Development: Contribute to the development of new technologies and solutions.
* Fleet Management: Manage and optimize the use of our installation vehicles.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional languages, including Swedish, are considered an advantage.
* Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Technical understanding, particularly within IT.
* Proven experience in project management or operational roles.
* Experience with logistics, ideally international.
* Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in the field, while reliably following direction and reporting lines from company headquarters in Stockholm.

**Personality & Traits**

* Self-Going: A proactive self-starter who takes ownership of problems and drives them to resolution without needing to be told twice, while staying aligned with HQ direction and reporting expectations.

* A Multitasker: You thrive juggling many priorities at once.
* Service-Minded: You take a customer-oriented approach and create value for colleagues and partners alike.

You can see the big picture while finding efficient solutions to complex problems. Your positive attitude and customer focus make you a valued colleague and partner — and your independence is matched by a genuine willingness to stay closely coordinated with, and take direction from, our Stockholm headquarters.

A dynamic, international work environment in an innovative industry.

The opportunity to influence and shape operations at a growing company.

Competitive salary and benefits

jobs.title: Account Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**

**About SafelyYou**

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.  
  
Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.  
  
SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

**Your Role at SafelyYou**  
We're standing up a new function in Revenue Operations and looking for the right person to own it. Between a signed contract and a live, billing customer, a lot has to go right — operator transitions, decommissions, change orders, implementation handoffs, billing syncs, pilot milestones. This role owns that entire lifecycle. You'll come in, learn how these processes work today, identify where they break down, and build the systems — including AI-powered automation — to run them reliably at scale. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, CS, and Implementation, with real cross-functional authority and accountability for outcomes. It's a high-visibility role with a direct line to how accurately and efficiently we convert commercial commitments into revenue.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Account Transitions & Decommissions**: When an operator acquires a property, exits a market, or transfers community management, there's a real process that spans contracting, implementation, customer success, and finance. You own that process end-to-end — intake through resolution — coordinating across teams and serving as the operational lead alongside the account manager. You'll also capture structured data on each event so patterns surface to leadership over time.
* **Contract-to-Billing:** Own the data and reconciliation work that keeps ARR and billing accurate across systems: contract data entry, tracking go-live dates, syncing billing updates, and catching discrepancies before they compound into reporting problems. Attend the weekly revenue meeting as an operational resource who can help resolve issues in real time, not just report on status.
* **Change Orders & Pilots:** Own the intake and tracking of contract amendments and expansions through to resolution. Manage pilot operations — milestone monitoring, flagging stalls, and driving decisions before delays cost billing revenue.
* **Post-Close Coordination**: Own the handoff from signed contract to implementation and customer success. Track what needs to happen after close and make sure it does.
* **Automation & Process Design:** Identify the manual, repetitive coordination work in this function and systematically eliminate it. Design and deploy automated monitoring for open milestones, billing dates, and discrepancies. Build workflows and AI-powered tools that let you operate proactively rather than reactively.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

***Required***

* 3–6 years in an operations role with real ownership — Revenue Operations, CS Operations, Implementation, or Commercial Operations in B2B SaaS or healthcare tech
* Demonstrated ability to run complex, cross-functional processes end-to-end and be accountable for outcomes, not just inputs
* Salesforce proficiency: you maintain data with discipline and can diagnose what a bad record costs downstream
* Experience with project or workflow management tools (Monday.com, Asana, or equivalent) for tracking multi-party, multi-step work
* Comfort operating across Sales, Finance, CS, and Implementation simultaneously — moving things forward without a manager brokering every conversation
* Experience in senior living, multi-site healthcare, or a comparably complex B2B environment is a meaningful advantage

***How You Work***

* You see broken processes as problems to fix, not facts to work around — your instinct is root cause, not workaround
* You're genuinely interested in AI and automation and have used these tools to make your own work faster; you're ready to build with them systematically, not just use them ad hoc
* You bring composure to difficult or sensitive situations — including customer-facing conversations in the middle of a stressful transition or decommission
* You communicate proactively and clearly across functions, surfacing issues before they become someone else's emergency
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and can prioritize across competing demands without needing everything defined upfront

**Salary Range:** *$140,000 - $160,000 USD commensurate with experience*

**Why Join Us? You Can Make a Difference!**

SafelyYou offers a competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

* A mission-driven company culture
* Fully remote
* Competitive salary & benefits, including fully paid employee premiums for Medical, Dental, and Vision
* 401k Program
* Monthly Education, Well-being & WFH stipends
* Non-accrual PTO
* Growth Potential
* Company Retreats
* Medical & Family/Parental Leave

At SafelyYou, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace makes us a more relevant, competitive, and resilient company. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce that celebrates diversity. We do not discriminate based on race,

jobs.title: Project Manager - Executive Scope
jobs.description:
**R3VOLUTION AD SERVICES, INC.**

Project Manager (Executive Scope) — Client Acquisition, Government Contracts, Team Leadership

R3volution AD Services, Inc. — Houston, Texas | Full-time | 100% Remote | $65,000 base + 3% commission + bonuses

New Orleans Soul. Texas Backbone. Marketing Done Right.

This seat is the right hand to the Founder & Head CEO. It exists for one reason: bring in regional and government accounts, and keep them. Everything else — systems, team, build schedule — is the machine revenue runs through, and you run the machine. The title is Project Manager; the work is executive, with a path to Operations Manager and Chief Operating Officer.

Read the whole post. The application is a test, and the instructions are not all in one place.

Step One Is a Video. No Video, No Application.

Record one Loom (loom.com, free account) in six parts, in this order. The free plan gives you five minutes; the parts add up to exactly 5:00. Hitting the mark is your first test of delivering under a hard limit.

Part 1 — The Open (0:15, camera on). Face visible. State your full name, your city and country, your committed Houston (US Central) overlap hours, and say the application code word from the bottom of this post out loud. No code word in the first 15 seconds and we stop watching there.

Part 2 — The Pitch (1:15, camera on, one take, no script). You are on a discovery call with the Director of Marketing at a 200-employee regional healthcare group. Sell R3volution AD Services. We are listening for how you open, whether you sell an outcome, and whether you ask for a next step.

Part 3 — The Pipeline (1:30, screen share). Open a CRM, pipeline or project board you personally ran (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho, Salesforce, ClickUp, Google Sheets). Walk one real account from first contact to close: the stages, how follow-up was tracked, where it stalled, what you did to unstick it. Blur the client if you must; we are judging the structure, not the logo. No CRM to show? Open whatever you actually used — a spreadsheet, a board, a doc — and walk the same account. If you never tracked a pipeline anywhere, that is the answer we are listening for.

Part 4 — Something You Built (1:00, screen share). Open the inside of one thing you built yourself: a live Zap with filters or paths, a ManyChat flow, an SOP, a dashboard. Walk the logic. Then tell us one thing that broke in it and exactly how you fixed it. "I used the tool" and "I built the tool" look different within ten seconds.

Part 5 — The Pressure Test (0:45, camera on, unscripted). Answer cold, no slides: "A retained client is six weeks into a campaign, the numbers are flat, and they email saying they want to cancel. You have that call in one hour. What do you open with, and what do you ask for before you hang up?"

Part 6 — The Setup Check (0:15, screen share). Share your screen, open speedtest.net or fast.com, press Go, and let the result appear on camera. Then say your backup internet plan and your backup power plan, one sentence each.

Rules: total runtime 5:00 — not 4:10, not 5:40. One continuous take per part: no cuts, slides, script, AI voice or avatar. English throughout. Link must open without a login.

Who We Are

R3volution AD Services, Inc. is a Houston, Texas digital marketing, AI platform development and government contracting firm, operating since 2017. We build custom AI-powered systems — including our own CRM and AI voice-calling platform — for healthcare, legal, manufacturing and public-sector clients, run three proprietary AI platforms (FundedAIPro, PromoFlowAI, InfiniteCMO), and work an active government pipeline. You report directly to the Founder & Head CEO.

The One Thing That Matters Most

This seat exists to bring in clients and keep them. If you run beautiful operations and the client list does not grow, you have failed the role.

Think like an owner, run it like a project manager. You will be managing projects, but the standard is an owner's: every dollar, every day lost, every client call and every slipped date is yours as if the company were yours. We are growing — new markets, new platforms, more government work — and we are hiring the person who has done this before and intends to be here at year 3, 10 and 30.

The target is regional and above: regional healthcare groups, multi-office law firms, mid-market and enterprise manufacturers, multi-state B2B operators. Local accounts are fine but not what this seat is measured on. Government — municipal, county, state, federal — is a priority lane. Then you keep them. Churn on an account you closed is your number.

The 90-day clock. Your application includes a 90-day client acquisition plan (it is in the 15 application questions). If no account is closed inside your first 90 days, we treat that as a clear signal this seat is not the right fit, and we act on it.

The Six Mandates

Mandate One — Revenue. Get clients. Keep clients. Your standing first priority, every day.

* Build the target account list: named companies, named decision-makers, verified contact data, tiered by value. Run outbound Monday through Saturday — LinkedIn, email, calls, referral and partner channels. Pick the niche you can win in and stay in it until it pays.

* Qualify every inbound inquiry and warm reply within 4 business hours.

* Sit in client meetings with the CEO, then run discovery calls yourself once you have earned it. Speaking of which: the first words out of your mouth in Part 2 of your Loom, before you pitch a single thing, are the dollar value of the largest contract you have ever personally closed. Say the number. Then sell. A closer who cannot say their number out loud has not got one.

* You close. Proposals, scopes and pricing packets are yours to produce; the contract is yours to bring across the line. Once you have proven it, you build and train a sales team to close the same way.

* Government lane: watch SAM.gov and state, county and city portals; keep a live bid calendar; deliver

jobs.title: Scaffolding Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of temporary tent structures, scaffolding systems, and related event infrastructure. This role oversees projects from initial planning and site assessment through installation, event operations, dismantling, and post-project review.

The Project Manager works closely with clients, sales teams, operations, engineers, vendors, crew leads, and field staff to ensure that temporary structures are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in accordance with project requirements, site conditions, manufacturer specifications, and applicable safety standards. This a National role and does not need to be located in one of our offices. Travel will be required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage tent structure, scaffolding, and temporary infrastructure projects from planning through completion.
* Review project requirements, site plans, drawings, layouts, specifications, and installation schedules.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Clients, vendors, engineers, and field crews to establish project scope, requirements, and expectations.
* Conduct or coordinate site assessments to identify access limitations, ground conditions, utilities, overhead obstructions, staging areas, and other potential installation challenges.
* Develop project timelines, installation schedules, dismantling plans, equipment requirements, and crew requirements.
* Coordinate tent structure and scaffolding equipment, components, hardware, ballast, rigging, flooring, lighting, and other required materials.
* Work with asset and logistics teams to develop accurate load lists and coordinate transportation to and from job sites.
* Coordinate delivery, staging, installation, inspection, modification, and dismantling of temporary structures.
* Work closely with crew leads to ensure structures are installed efficiently and according to approved plans and procedures.
* Monitor project progress and make adjustments to labor, equipment, schedules, and logistics as required.
* Job Costing – coordinating with Sales & Operations and Management to review project estimates, change orders and additional labor or equipment impacting job cost.
* Identify potential structural, safety, logistical, or operational issues before and during installation and implement appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate with engineering or qualified technical personnel when site conditions or project requirements require structural review or engineering input.
* Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable safety requirements, manufacturer specifications, approved plans, and company procedures.
* Maintain a strong focus on fall protection, site safety, lifting operations, equipment handling, and safe work practices.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-installation and post-installation inspections as required.
* Verify that completed structures meet project requirements and maintain a professional, high-quality presentation.
* Coordinate setup and takedown activities to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within established timelines.
* Communicate project changes, scope changes, site conditions, additional labor, equipment requirements, and potential cost impacts to Sales and management promptly.
* Provide End-of-Day Reports, project updates, and post-event After Action Reports.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, equipment, structures, or enhancements that may benefit the client.
* Provide constructive feedback and practical solutions for challenges encountered in the field.
* Maintain positive working relationships with clients, crews, subcontractors, vendors, venues, and internal departments.
* Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accurate documentation and communication.
* Create a professional and positive team environment both in the office and at job sites.
* Travel to local, in-state, and out-of-state job sites as required.
* Work evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on project schedules.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* Experience with large-scale temporary tent structures.
* Experience with scaffolding installation or project coordination.
* Construction or event-production background.
* Familiarity with temporary structure engineering, anchoring, ballast, and load requirements.
* OSHA or equivalent safety training.
* Familiarity with site plans, CAD drawings, structural drawings, or technical documentation.
* Experience managing union or non-union field crews.
* Experience coordinating cranes, forklifts, lifts, trucking, and other heavy equipment.
* Experience working with engineers, structural consultants, or permitting authorities.

**Disclaimer:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

The Project Manager leads cross-functional teams, coordinates internal and external partners, and keeps projects moving toward organizational goals.

The PMO works as both a project lead and a consulting partner. * Lead cross-departmental teams, making roles, responsibilities, and goals clear for everyone involved

* Serve as the main point of contact when multiple teams or departments share a project so everyone stays aligned

* Support the integration of acquired or partner businesses onto LAZ systems and processes

* Lay out options and tradeoffs so sponsors and stakeholders can make timely decisions

* Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience

**Experience**

* 5+ years of project management experience, ideally in a PMO or multi-department setting

* Experience leading software or system implementations with outside vendors

* Experience with business integrations, operational transitions, or process changes across multiple departments is a plus

**Skills**

* Leads cross-functional teams without direct authority, including resolving conflicts and negotiating effectively

* Manages vendor and partner relationships, keeping outside teams accountable to timelines and deliverables

* Prioritizes tasks, manages time, and handles multiple projects across different departments at once

* Works comfortably with people at every level of the organization, from frontline teams to executives

* Strong written communication, including clear meeting recaps, status updates, and executive summaries

jobs.description:
**Data Analytics Program Manager**

**Role Overview**

A large e-commerce and logistics client is looking for a data-first program operator to own the analytics backbone of a fast-scaling energy and power planning function. This person manages large, complex datasets across hundreds to thousands of active sites in various stages of planning, due diligence, capital approval, and construction - translating raw data into decisions and building the tracking infrastructure the team runs on.

This is not a traditional program manager role. The core skillset is data - querying it, modeling it, centralizing it, and making it actionable. Strong operational discipline ensures that analytical outputs actually drive cross-functional alignment, risk visibility, and on-time delivery across PMO, Finance, Capital Management, Pre-Construction, and Construction stakeholders.

**What You'll Do**

Own and maintain centralized trackers spanning the full site lifecycle - from demand forecasting and site selection through power due diligence, capital approval, utility engagement, and construction delivery

* - across a portfolio of hundreds to thousands of locations simultaneously
* Build and manage data models that integrate inputs from multiple internal and third-party sources into a single, reliable source of truth for portfolio health, risk, cost, and timeline status
* Design and stand up risk tracking frameworks that embed site-level due diligence outputs directly into downstream PMO and capital workflows, closing handoff gaps between site selection and delivery teams
* Produce executive-level reporting and dashboards that surface portfolio risk, cost variance, milestone status, and coverage gaps in real time
Identify data gaps, ownership ambiguities, and process breakdowns across stakeholder groups and build the mechanisms to fix them* - trackers, playbooks, operating rhythms, and escalation frameworks
* Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure utility infrastructure and interconnect costs flow accurately into capital approval budgets
* Drive automation opportunities across high-frequency data workflows and define requirements for tooling improvements

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years in a data analyst or data-heavy program management role managing large, multi-variable datasets across complex portfolios
PMP certification or equivalent* - used to structure ambiguity, not just manage schedules
* Advanced Excel/Sheets and hands-on BI tool experience (Tableau, Power BI, Quicksight, or similar)
* SQL proficiency; Python a strong plus
* Proven ability to build centralized tracking and reporting infrastructure from scratch across multiple stakeholder groups
Experience in capital-intensive industries* - energy, utilities, infrastructure, real estate, or logistics strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work backward from a messy data landscape and build clean, scalable systems that others depend on

jobs.title: Patient Engagement Specialist (CareSync Coordinator)
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

**Department:** Patient Support Center – CareSync

**Position Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.

**Who We Are**

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.

**The Role**

The **Patient Engagement Specialist** is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.

This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion**

* Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
* Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
* Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
* Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
* Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

**Process Referrals Accurately**

* Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
* Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
* Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
* Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

**Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers**

* Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
* Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
* Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

**Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls**

* Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
* Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

**Grow Through Coaching & Quality**

* Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
* Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
* Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

**Own the Patient & Provider Experience**

* Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
* Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
* Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

**Who You Are**

* A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
* Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
* Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
* A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
* Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
* Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
* Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

**What You Bring**

* 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
* Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
* Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickl

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Job Description:

**Must be able to work in Eastern standard time zone or Central.**

The Care Coordination Specialist works under RN supervision to provide coordinated care services for injured workers with low to moderate complexity claims. This position ensures continuity of medical services and facilitates communication between all parties involved while supporting return-to-work efforts within workers' compensation guidelines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Care Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate routine medical care needs for assigned injured workers under established protocols
* Facilitate communication between injured workers, providers, employers, and adjusters for straightforward cases
* Collect and document clinical information from healthcare providers and claimants
* Schedule and coordinate medical appointments, diagnostics, and ancillary services
* Communicate work status updates to injured workers, employers, and claims adjusters

**Case Management Support**

* Follow established care plans and treatment protocols under RN supervision
* Monitor injured worker adherence to treatment plans and compare progress to established guidelines
* Maintain accurate documentation of medical history and case progress in WC system using approved formats
* Facilitate return-to-work efforts through coordination with employers and providers
* Escalate cases to RN supervision when clinical complexity increases beyond the scope

**Administrative Functions**

* Maintain and update case review notes and documentation on all assigned cases
* Complete time management tracking on all cases
* Attend team meetings and training sessions as scheduled
* Ensure cost containment through the utilization of in-network providers when appropriate
* Support network provider coordination efforts

jobs.title: Proposal Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Xenith Solutions**
--------------------------

Xenith Solutions is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) delivering technology, engineering, and mission support services to federal government customers. We are expanding our prime contracting portfolio and investing in the people, processes, and capabilities needed to support continued growth.  
We are seeking a Proposal Operations Coordinator to join our Growth & Strategy team and play an important role in the planning, coordination, and execution of our federal proposal development efforts.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

The Proposal Operations Coordinator is responsible for organizing and coordinating Xenith's proposal development activities, ensuring that contributors understand their responsibilities, schedules remain on track, reviews are effectively conducted, and submissions meet established quality and compliance standards.  
This is a hands-on position for someone who understands the federal proposal development process, enjoys bringing structure to complex efforts, and knows how to keep a team moving toward a common deadline.  
The successful candidate will combine practical proposal experience with exceptional organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. They must be comfortable working with experienced professionals across multiple disciplines and organizational levels, facilitating productive working sessions, maintaining accountability for deliverables, and addressing obstacles before they affect proposal quality or schedule.  
This role emphasizes proposal coordination, process execution, editorial quality, compliance, and production. Substantive technical writing, capture strategy, and solution development remain the responsibilities of designated pursuit leaders and subject matter experts.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Proposal Planning and Coordination**

* Develop and maintain proposal schedules, milestones, contributor assignments, compliance matrices, and production plans.
* Coordinate proposal kickoff meetings, working sessions, status meetings, and review activities.
* Facilitate productive meetings, establish clear expectations, and ensure that assignments, deadlines, and action items are understood.
* Monitor contributor progress, proactively follow up on commitments, and identify potential schedule or resource conflicts.
* Coordinate professionals across multiple functions and organizational levels, maintaining productive working relationships and accountability without formal supervisory authority.
* Manage multiple concurrent proposal activities, balancing competing priorities and submission deadlines.
* Identify emerging risks to proposal execution and coordinate timely resolution or escalation.
* Manage final proposal assembly, quality assurance, production, and submission readiness.

### **Proposal Process, Compliance, and Quality**

* Support structured proposal development processes consistent with Shipley or comparable industry methodologies.
* Plan and coordinate formal color team reviews, including review preparation, participant coordination, documentation of findings, and tracking corrective actions.
* Analyze solicitations and acquisition documents to identify proposal instructions, evaluation criteria, submission requirements, and compliance obligations.
* Develop and maintain compliance matrices, proposal outlines, and submission checklists.
* Review proposal content for clarity, consistency, grammar, formatting, completeness, and responsiveness to solicitation requirements.
* Identify content gaps, inconsistencies, and potential compliance issues, coordinating corrections with responsible contributors.
* Prepare and maintain standard corporate proposal sections, administrative responses, and approved reusable materials.
* Maintain document configuration control and ensure accurate, complete, and professionally prepared submissions.

### **Process Improvement and Knowledge Management**

* Maintain organized repositories of proposal templates, corporate qualifications, past performance references, approved content, and supporting materials.
* Develop and refine proposal workflows, checklists, and document management practices to improve consistency and efficiency.
* Support post-submission lessons-learned reviews and incorporate improvements into future proposal activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve proposal operations through practical application of technology, automation, and process refinement.
* Use approved AI-assisted and other productivity tools to support document analysis, editing, compliance verification, and administrative efficiency while maintaining appropriate information security and content validation standards.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Minimum of two years of hands-on experience supporting competitive proposal development.
* Working familiarity with Shipley or a comparable structured proposal development methodology, including formal color team reviews.
* Direct experience supporting multiple proposal development cycles, including planning, contributor coordination, reviews, production, and submission.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate deadline-driven activities involving multiple contributors with differing responsibilities and priorities.
* Strong meeting facilitation, organizational, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience developing and maintaining proposal schedules, compliance matrices, assignment trackers, and production documentation.
* Strong editing, proofreading, and document quality-control capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaborative document management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate geographically distributed contributors and facilitate effective virtual meetings.
* Ability to work independently, anticipate problems, manage competing priorities, and communicate confidently

jobs.title: Medical Editor – Arbitration & IDR Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
Medical Editor – Arbitration & IDR Quality Assurance Specialist

**Elite Billing & Collections | Remote Position**

About the Position

Elite Billing & Collections is seeking an experienced, highly detail-oriented **Medical Editor** to join our growing Arbitration and Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR) team.

This position is responsible for reviewing, editing, and strengthening arbitration submissions prepared by our paralegal team. The Medical Editor will serve as a critical quality assurance checkpoint, ensuring that every submission presents a clear, persuasive, medically accurate, and well-supported argument.

We are looking for someone who understands medical documentation, can identify weaknesses in written arguments, and has the ability to elevate the overall quality and effectiveness of our arbitration submissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Review and edit completed arbitration and IDR submissions prepared by paralegals.
* Evaluate the strength, clarity, accuracy, and persuasiveness of medical and reimbursement arguments.
* Strengthen medical narratives by highlighting procedural complexity, patient acuity, medical necessity, provider expertise, and other relevant clinical factors supported by the documentation.
* Review operative reports, clinical records, and supporting exhibits to ensure arguments accurately reflect the medical services performed.
* Identify weak arguments, missing information, inconsistencies, and opportunities to strengthen submissions.
* Ensure all claims and supporting statements are factually accurate and substantiated by medical records or other appropriate evidence.
* Verify medical terminology, procedural descriptions, diagnoses, and CPT codes for accuracy and consistency.
* Ensure submissions are professionally written, properly structured, and free of grammatical or formatting errors.
* Provide constructive feedback to paralegals to improve the overall quality of future submissions.
* Collaborate with paralegals and management to resolve documentation discrepancies and address quality concerns.
* Maintain high productivity and quality standards while reviewing a substantial volume of arbitration cases.
* Ensure submissions meet internal quality standards and applicable arbitration or IDR requirements.

Required Qualifications

* Professional experience in medical editing, medical writing, clinical documentation, medical billing, or a related healthcare field.
* Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, surgical procedures, and clinical documentation.
* Exceptional editing, proofreading, and professional writing skills.
* Ability to critically evaluate written arguments and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Experience interpreting operative reports and medical records.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or unsupported statements.
* Excellent time management skills and ability to meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with medical arbitration, Independent Dispute Resolution (IDR), or the No Surprises Act (NSA).
* Experience reviewing medical necessity arguments, reimbursement appeals, or insurance disputes.
* Background in orthopedic surgery, spine surgery, pain management, or other surgical specialties.
* CPC, CCS, RN, or other relevant healthcare credentials.
* Experience in quality assurance, medical documentation auditing, or medical-legal editing.

What We're Looking For

**This is not simply a proofreading position.**

We need someone who can critically assess the quality of an arbitration submission, recognize where the medical or reimbursement arguments are weak, and make meaningful improvements that strengthen the case.

The ideal candidate will have exceptional analytical skills, strong medical knowledge, and the ability to ensure every submission is accurate, professional, persuasive, and supported by appropriate documentation.

Our goal is to produce consistently high-quality arbitration submissions that effectively communicate the medical complexity and relevant circumstances of each case.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume highlighting your experience in medical editing, clinical documentation review, medical writing, or healthcare reimbursement.

Candidates with experience reviewing complex medical records and strengthening medical or reimbursement arguments are strongly encouraged to apply.

Position is fully remote. Benefits not included except Paid Time Off.

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

Through the completion of multiple mergers, acquisitions and organic growth the company is continuing to grow rapidly across the country. The Splicing Program Manager is responsible for the planning, staffing, production, quality, and financial performance of fiber splicing operations across an assigned region. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Catalis is a leading government Software as a Service (SaaS) and integrated payments provider, powering a wide range of government operations at the municipal, county, state, and federal levels. Our innovative solutions are designed to streamline processes, enhance efficiency, and improve the delivery of government services to the public. At Catalis, we are committed to leveraging technology to make government interactions simpler, faster, and more accessible.

  
  

**The Opportunity**

This role is for builders, fixers, and change makers—not caretakers of pristine accounts. If you are energized by complexity, motivated by turnaround stories, and comfortable leading customers through change, you will thrive here.

You will work with customers at varying stages of maturity, some of whom are navigating operational challenges related to legacy technology, historical service experiences, and process gaps. Your mission is to stabilize relationships, rebuild confidence, and help customers progress toward more modern, scalable solutions.

  
  

Success in this role requires resilience, creativity, and the ability to think on your feet. You will frequently operate without a playbook, navigating ambiguity while guiding customers from legacy, on-premise solutions toward modern SaaS offerings. This role is equal parts relationship builder, problem solver, translator, and change leader.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  
  

**Customer Retention & Relationship Management**

* Own a portfolio of complex customer relationships and serve as the primary point of accountability for the overall experience
* Manage escalations related to support, billing, invoicing, and legacy system limitations, partnering across teams to drive resolution
* Identify retention risks and take proactive steps to stabilize accounts and rebuild confidence
* Lead account conversations focused on clarity, progress, and next steps—even in ambiguous or under-documented environments

**Customer Growth & Modernization**

* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders through consistency, transparency, and follow-through
* Guide customers from legacy, on-premise solutions toward modern SaaS offerings
* Identify and advance expansion and upsell opportunities aligned to customer needs and platform strategy

**Execution & Collaboration**

* Operate independently and make sound decisions with incomplete information
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Support, Product, Finance, Sales, and Engineering to move customer issues forward
* Support onboarding, renewals, and ongoing engagement to ensure continuity of service

Requirements

**What you Will Need to Succeed**

* 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a customer-facing role within SaaS, technology, or complex B2B environments
* Demonstrated ability to manage unhappy or at-risk customers and rebuild trust
* High tolerance for ambiguity
* Strong relationship-building skills, including the confidence to have difficult conversations
* Exceptional problem-solving instincts and the ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously
* Comfort operating independently
* Persistence and an optimistic mindset—even in challenging situations
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Travel up to 35%, primarily for on-site customer meetings, relationship rebuilding, and strategic engagements
* Because this position has access to criminal justice information, you must be able to complete Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) related training and pass a secondary FBI Level background check.
  

  

**What We Offer**

* A dynamic and supportive work environment in a mission driven organization
* Competitive salary and benefits package, including health, dental, vision insurance
* Unlimited PTO (paid time off)
* HSA and FSA options
* 401(k) plan with matching contributions
* Paid parental leave
* ABLE matching contributions for the disability community
* Employer paid short term and long-term disability insurance and group term life insurance
* Financial and legal assistance through our EAP (Employee Assistance Program)
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement
* The chance to make a significant impact on the delivery of government services and the lives of citizens.
  

  

**EEO Statement**

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We are committed to an inclusive environment for all. All candidates will be considered based on qualifications, merit, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, non-qualifying mental or physical disability, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

### **Description**

If you enjoy building strong relationships, solving technical challenges, and making a meaningful impact for customers, this role is for you. Behind every major process facility is an EPC firm making high-stakes decisions about the equipment that will run it for decades.  
  
As FS-Elliott’s Account Manager for EPC Accounts across the Americas, you will be the trusted partner those firms rely on when compression is on the line, helping them identify the right integrally geared centrifugal compressor solutions and guiding them from early project stages through award, installation, and long-term support. You will collaborate across teams, travel throughout the region from Canada to South America, and play a central role in expanding FS-Elliott’s presence in these important markets.

### **What You'll Do**

  

* Own the EPC relationship. Serve as FS-Elliott’s primary contact for your EPC accounts and their end-user clients, and represent their requirements to our engineering, product management, and project teams.
* Win the specification. Engage EPC process and rotating equipment engineers at the front end of projects and position FS-Elliott solutions before the bid package is issued.
* Lead the pursuit. Build strategic sales plans for target projects, direct Sales Support through the quoting and bid process, and deliver technical presentations to current and prospective customers.
* Solve the hard applications. Partner with Product Management to develop alternative solutions when an application falls outside our standard product line.
* Close the deal. Negotiate orders and contracts alongside Finance, Legal, and Contracts Administration, identifying technical and commercial risks early and building mitigation plans.
* Stay with the customer. Coordinate with our Aftermarket team through installation and commissioning, and grow the relationship into long-term service and future project business.
* Know the market. Track EPC project activity and competitor offerings across the Americas, share market intelligence, contribute to product and process improvement, and maintain an accurate pipeline and forecast in Salesforce.

  

### **What You Bring**

  

* Experience selling engineered equipment, ideally rotating equipment or compressors, to EPC firms or industrial end users
* Working knowledge of how EPC projects are specified, bid, and awarded, including vendor qualification and technical bid evaluation
* A basic technical understanding of compressed air and gas compression systems, and the confidence to discuss it with engineers
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage customers with clarity and care
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and persuasion skills with sound business judgment
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach with the curiosity to understand challenges and find the right path forward
* A collaborative mindset focused on team and customer success, with the ability to work independently
* Dependability, integrity, and ownership in managing responsibilities and commitments
* The organization to manage multiple long-cycle pursuits and priorities while meeting deadlines
* Willingness to travel up to 50% to support customer relationships
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, ERP tools, and Salesforce CRM
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or business preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

### **About FS-Elliott**

FS-Elliott is a global leader in the engineering and manufacturing of oil-free, centrifugal compressors with operations in over 90 countries. Building on a 50-year tradition of excellence, we combine an unwavering commitment to quality with the desire for advancing technology to bring value to our customers, allowing them to increase their productivity and lower system operating costs.

* Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle, insurance eligibility and benefits verification, prior authorizations, or a related field.
* Strong working knowledge of insurance eligibility, coordination of benefits (COB), payer authorization requirements, claims, and billing episode setup.
* Experience working with Medicaid, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and commercial insurance plans across multiple states.
* Demonstrated ability to review eligibility-related rejections, denial reports, authorization reports, and error reports to identify discrepancies and ensure timely account updates.

Dompé is an Italian bio-pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovation, where a long tradition in the field of personal wellness goes hand-in-hand with a commitment to research and development to meet unsatisfied therapeutic needs.

  

Established in 1940 in Milan, Dompé has an industrial and biotech research hub in L’Aquila, in addition to branches in Europe (Barcelona, Berlin, Paris and Tirana). The company has approximately 900 employees. The US headquarters of Dompé are based in Boston (R&D) and in the San Francisco Bay Area (Commercial Operations).

**YOUR ROLE AT DOMPÉ**

The Patient Access Manager reports to the Associate Director, Patient Access Manager and will be a key member of the US organization supporting the company’s efforts related to cenegermin eye drops, which are based on rhNGF (recombinant human nerve growth factor).

Approved in August 2018, OxervateTM eye drops (cenegermin-bkbj ophthalmic solution) is the first-ever topical biologic medication approved in ophthalmology and the first treatment indicated for neurotrophic keratitis (NK), a rare and progressive eye disease that can lead to corneal scarring and visual loss. Oxervate is also the first-ever application of a human nerve growth factor (NGF) as drug or treatment.

The Patient Access Manager (PAM) will be responsible for supporting and maintaining patient support services that maximize access to our product for patients to whom it has been prescribed. The PAM will execute pre-defined strategies and role requirements to address patient access needs. The PAM will manage specific service levels and contribute to managing the performance of the team. The PAM will also be a member of the field leadership team by playing a customer-facing role and work closely with our Field Access Managers (FAMs) to support the needs of physicians and their patients in the field (limited field travel as this role is primarily home office based). The PAM will work with the team to improve existing materials as well as identify, design, and roll out patient access materials as needed. There is also an opportunity to collaborate with stakeholders across the company, influence the development of the Patient Services organization, and shape the culture of Dompé US.

The Patient Access Manager will be accountable for abiding by the core values of our Dompé culture, which are Integrity, Speed, Knowledge, Passion, Attention to Detail, Reliability, Flexibility and Teamwork. The Patient Access Manager (PAM) plays a critical, non-promotional role focused on facilitating patient access to Oxervate through advanced case management support. **Responsibilities:**

* **Oversee Vendor Execution:** Direct the day-to-day work of our speaker program vendor across logistics, registration, attendee management, and speaker coordination. Set clear expectations, monitor performance against SLAs and KPIs, and resolve or escalate gaps.

* **Report and Improve:** Work with our vendor to maintain trackers and standard reports on program activity, speaker utilization, exceptions, and vendor performance. Work with the product team to simplify and automate high-volume work and strengthen SOPs.

**Who You Are**

* You have a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in event operations, speaker program operations, project management, commercial operations, or a related field.
* Experience managing vendors that deliver high-volume programs or events, including tracking deliverables and resolving issues through appropriate escalation.
* Working knowledge of the rules governing interactions with healthcare professionals, such as the PhRMA Code, Anti-Kickback Statute, OIG guidance on speaker programs, and Open Payments (Sunshine Act) reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to manage many concurrent programs with strong organization and attention to detail.
* Experience supporting structured Commercial, Medical, regulatory, or other content-review and approval processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, including intermediate Excel, and the ability to learn program-management, content-management, and workflow platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The Supported Employment Program Manager provides oversight to Ritter Center’s Individual Placement and Support (IPS) program, a model of supported employment for people with serious mental illness. * Serves as primary lead for IPS fidelity reviews, corrective action plans, implementation monitoring, and coordination with the California IPS Center of Excellence.
* Ensures compliance with DHCS, Medi-Cal, HIPAA, BHRS, CalAIM, Behavioral Health Services Act (BHSA), and applicable federal, state, and county requirements.
* Prepares for and participates in county, state, federal, and fidelity audits, monitoring visits, corrective action processes, and reporting reviews.
* Provides individual supervision for employment specialists. Supervision includes some office-based sessions, as well working side-by-side with specialists.
* Collects client outcomes monthly. Shares outcomes for the program, as well as individual practitioners, with the supported employment team each quarter.
* Helps team members set goals, review individual outcomes, and develop written plans to refine skills and improve outcomes.
* Acts as a liaison to other department coordinators and administrators in the organization.
* Communicates regularly with mental health supervisors to ensure that services are integrated, to resolve issues, and to act as a proponent for employment.
* Works with the division of BHRS to coordinate services. Coordinates monthly meetings between team members to discuss how to help people served by both agencies.
* Leads or participates in steering committee meetings to help with IPS supported employment implementation and sustainability.
* Provides supported employment services when the team needs additional support.
* Verifies/approves bi-weekly staff timesheets.
* Other duties as assigned

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in behavioral health, rehabilitation, counseling, social work, psychology, public health, or a related field. Equivalent years’ experience can be substituted for education requirement.
* Previous supported employment experience and/or community job placement services
* Previous experience in the behavioral health field
* Previous supervisory experience

* **Meaningful Impact**: Help to transform the lives of foster youth on the cusp of adulthood. Your role will support them in their journey to conquer challenges, achieve independence, and fulfill their aspirations.
* **Innovative Approach:** We thrive on innovation, pushing the boundaries of foster care support. Your voice here matters, and you’ll contribute to programs that redefine the futures of these young lives.
* **Collaborative and Supportive Environment:** Embrace a dynamic and supportive workplace, where every team member is valued. Together, we're a force dedicated to uplifting youth. Expect professional growth, fueled by teamwork and collaboration.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We value the well-being of our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package. From health and wellness benefits to retirement plans, we ensure that our team members are taken care of so they can focus on their important work supporting foster youth.
* **Culture of Diversity and Inclusion:** We celebrate diversity in every form. At First Place for Youth, inclusivity reigns, creating a workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and empowered.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Clinical Manager is an energetic, collaborative and results-oriented leader who will supervise Master’s level social work and multi-disciplinary case management staff and manage overall operations of an integrated services program. This position oversees our Transitional Living Program (TLP) which serves young adults referred through the SF homeless response system, our Youth Transitions Partnership (YTP) which leverages Dialectical Behavior Therapy, an evidence-based therapy that is supported for use in young people, and our My First Place (MFP) programming, a transitional housing program for young adults in the foster care/juvenile justice systems. The Clinical Manager provides leadership to a staff team of up to 6 professional and additional support staff ensuring effective, accurate program implementation, excellence in participant care, adherence to First Place for Youth policies, and efficient operations. The Manager is responsible to monitor outcomes toward achieving program and individual youth outcomes. The Manager participates on the middle management team and is responsible to coordinate with other agency departments, hire and evaluate staff teams, develop resources and implement training to ensure a well-trained high functioning team, and to provide direct oversight of all aspects of program to ensure quality and compliance. The Clinical Manager reports to the Director of Programs.

This position requires a clinical professional whose passion for First Place’s vision is matched with energetic leadership, sound judgment in the face of complex challenges, and a proven track record of successfully managing direct-service teams. This is currently a hybrid position requiring onsite work at a minimum of two-three days per week-and/or as needed depending on business need. However, it is subject to change depending on the needs of the department and the organization.

**DUTIES + RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Program Staff Supervision**

* Hire, train, develop and supervise/coach a multi-disciplinary team of social work and case management staff including Youth Advocates/Social Workers and may include Employment and Education Specialists. Lead team members in setting personal and program-wide work goals and in maintaining accountability for goal achievement. Facilitate regular weekly program staff meetings. Conduct annual reviews of direct reports.
* Ensure fidelity to program model through weekly individual supervision with each staff person including routine field observations of staff. Lead or co-lead a clinical supervision group for clinical staff and staff working toward licensure, as assigned. Monitor staff effectiveness and support professional growth through review of outcome and practice data.
* Provide training and consultation grounded in evidence-based practice and First Place for Youth guiding principles including but not limited to trauma-informed care, positive youth development, strength-based approach and motivational interviewing. With management team, implement, train, and coach staff in best practice strategies.
* Ensure quality of services and accuracy and timeliness of all aspects of participant records including timely submission of all utilization, fidelity and outcome data. Participate in meetings to review participant progress and utilize data to evaluate progress and consider strategies to recalibrate intervention to ensure success. Include development of team-based strategies and excellent collaboration among team members.
* Ensure that all My First-Place staff are aligned with mission, values, and goals of First Place, capable of acting as ambassadors for the agency at all times, and focused on achieving outcomes, including integrated use of data and evaluative feedback.
* Provide direct intervention as needed including consultative support, crisis intervention, participation in or facilitation of meetings with youth, county workers, or other

**BENEFITS CASE MANAGER**

**The Center for Elders’ Independence (CEI)** provides a Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (P.A.C.E.) - a comprehensive healthcare model specifically designed for low-income, frail seniors. It combines medical and social services along with vigilant care planning and coordination in order to keep frail seniors safely living at home and in their communities. This unique and highly effective model utilizes an interdisciplinary team approach to care planning to drive high quality, affordable, integrated healthcare services to the elderly.

**Position****:** Under the supervision of Director of Enrollment and Member Services, the Benefits Case Manager ensures that all CEI participants are enrolled in all income and insurance benefits that they are eligible for. Benefits Case Manager will be required to work effectively with participants, participant families, representative payees and relevant government agencies to proactively maintain and address benefit eligibility issues that arise as well as support different prospect/participant benefit related projects within the agency.

The hourly pay range for the Benefits Case Manager position at Center for Elders’ Independence is $26.25 to $39.38. Placement within the range is determined based on job-related factors such as relevant experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and market data, consistent with CEI’s annual compensation review and established compensation practices.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Department and Caseload Management**

* Benefits Case Manager keeps track and ensures that all participants’ benefits eligibility needs are met; this includes working directly with the participants, participant families, representative payees and the relevant government agencies to proactively maintain benefit eligibility and resolve all eligibility issues that arise.
* Manages the assigned participant eligibility caseload which includes attending enrollment, care conference meetings and conducting home visits with participants where eligibility issues need to be addressed.
* Manages the caseload information on participants in a well-organized and secure filing system as devised by the department.
* Keeps track and monitors the eligibility status of the participant assigned to the caseload and generates regular reports as needed.

**Income Benefits**

* Ensures that the CEI participants’ income information assigned to the caseload is known and verified at all times and is well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that accurate share-of-cost information is gathered, well documented and communicated with the participant on the caseload and the finance staff in an effective and in a timely fashion to enable CEI to collect share-of-cost revenue.
* Works with the participants, families and social workers connected to the assigned caseload to ensure that the Board and Care and SNF income level changes are made by the social security administration, that all involved understand the changes and that the benefit levels are accurate on all Board and Care documents.
* Communicates income issues to social work, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to ensure interdepartmental effectiveness.

**Insurance Benefits**

* Ensures that all CEI participants’ benefit information on the assigned caseload is known and verified at all times and well documented in the CEI database.
* Ensures that CEI participants who are assigned to the caseload are fully enrolled in Medi-Cal and any Medicare benefits they are eligible for prior to enrollment and following enrollment (ie assist with getting participants who are Medi-Cal only qualify for Medicare and participant missing Medicare Part A qualified for QMB benefit to obtain Part A coverage).
* Manages Medi-Cal re-certification to ensure that eligibility is maintained for all participants and facilitate proper communication and documents if retro payment request needs to be processed for month reflecting no payment code.
* Verify IHSS enrollment information prior to enrollment and document in CEI database for proper termination after enrollment.
* Communicates insurance issues to social worker, finance, member services and other pertinent staff as needed affiliated with the participant on the caseload to sure interdepartmental effectiveness.

**Relevant Skills and Experience:**

* High School diploma required.
* Experience or knowledge in benefit such as Medi-Cal, Medicare and other common benefits available for seniors.
* Excellent customer service and service recovery skills.
* Strong case management skills. Ability to work closely with cross-functional team members including Outreach and Enrollment staff and IDT staff at the PACE centers.
* A demonstrated history of success in goal attainment.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both oral and written.
* Must be proficient with computer applications including spreadsheets, word processing and Customer Relationship Management (Salesforce).
* Excellent decision-making ability, customer service and negotiation.
* Possess the capacity to work in a high-stressed, high paced environment while maintaining a positive attitude.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Bilingual preferred: English/Spanish; English / Cantonese or Mandarin Chinese; English / Vietnamese or other.
* A passion for working with the senior and underserved populations.

**Physical and Travel Requirements:**

* Ability to sit, stand, stoop, reach, lift (up to 40 pounds), bend, etc.; hand and wrist dexterity to utilize keyboard.
* Travel within assigned territory and agency sites and programs.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation and insurance coverage required.

We are seeking an experienced Merchandising Operations Manager to lead the day-to-day processes that turn approved product and merchandising plans into accurate purchase orders, complete SKU records, and reliable reporting. This hands-on manager owns PO entry and management, SKU creation and integrity, and the development of one direct report, a Merchandise Coordinator.  
  
The role partners closely with Merchandising, Product, Sourcing, Production, Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, and eCommerce to keep product information and order details aligned from initial setup through website launch and fulfillment. The ideal candidate combines strong execution with people leadership, clear communication, and the ability to improve processes while coaching a less experienced team member.

People Management and Development

* Coach and train the direct report on PO entry and management, SKU creation, system integrity, reporting, and cross-functional communication.
* Conduct regular one-on-ones and performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and establish development goals that build independent ownership.
* Review work quality, address skill gaps through structured training, and gradually build the coordinator's independent ownership; maintain backup coverage for critical processes.

Purchase Order Entry and Management

* Own accurate and timely PO entry in the ERP or order management system based on approved buy plans and confirmed vendor information.

As one of our Operations Managers, you will take on a central role in planning and coordinating everything from logistics to technical installations across the US market. You will hold end-to-end ownership for ensuring our AI camera systems are delivered, installed, and running at peak performance, while safeguarding cost-efficiency and quality along the way.

This is a highly autonomous, self-starting role: you'll be expected to identify problems and drive solutions independently in the field, often without close day-to-day oversight. At the same time, you will work in close alignment with our headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, following the direction, standards, and processes set by HQ, and keeping the team there informed with clear, timely reporting. The role requires a combination of technical understanding, operational leadership, and the ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

We are looking for Operations Managers to be located in multiple locations in the US such as Miami (FL), Austin (TX), Atlanta (GA), etc.

The role will report to our General Manager for North America.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Logistics: Coordinate and optimize logistics for installations and operations across the US, and at times globally, in line with HQ guidelines.
* Procurement & Cost Control: Ensure cost-effective procurement and management of equipment and resources.

* Support: Advise and support our international offices on technology choices and technical issues.

* Overall Operations: Liaise with our support centers which handles monitoring and status reporting on operational performance, and help ensure reporting standards set by HQ are followed.
* AI Quality: Evaluate and ensure AI performance for existing and new sports.
* Research & Development: Contribute to the development of new technologies and solutions.
* Fleet Management: Manage and optimize the use of our installation vehicles.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent English, spoken and written. Additional languages, including Swedish, are considered an advantage.

**CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN THE UNITED STATES**

**About SafelyYou**

SafelyYou’s passionate mission is to empower safer, more person-centered care across senior living through world-leading AI, industry-changing hardware, and remote expert clinicians, significantly improving outcomes for residents while increasing peace of mind for families and reducing costs for communities.  
  
Originating in 2015 as the doctoral research of CEO George Netscher—and inspired by his own family's experience with Alzheimer's disease—SafelyYou was spun out of UC Berkeley’s Artificial Intelligence Research Lab, one of the top five AI research groups in the world. And today, our company is solving critical challenges in senior living, from resident falls and ER visits to staffing concerns, length of stay, and NOI. All helping ensure that communities can focus on improved care for residents while still reaching their financial goals.  
  
SafelyYou is one of five most innovative fall technologies referenced in the Senate Falls Report (2019), a winner of the McKnight’s Tech Partner of the Year, and has been named to Fortune’s Impact 20 list, which recognizes companies making people’s lives better through innovation.

**Your Role at SafelyYou**  
We're standing up a new function in Revenue Operations and looking for the right person to own it. Between a signed contract and a live, billing customer, a lot has to go right — operator transitions, decommissions, change orders, implementation handoffs, billing syncs, pilot milestones. This role owns that entire lifecycle. You'll come in, learn how these processes work today, identify where they break down, and build the systems — including AI-powered automation — to run them reliably at scale. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Finance, CS, and Implementation, with real cross-functional authority and accountability for outcomes. It's a high-visibility role with a direct line to how accurately and efficiently we convert commercial commitments into revenue.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Account Transitions & Decommissions**: When an operator acquires a property, exits a market, or transfers community management, there's a real process that spans contracting, implementation, customer success, and finance. You own that process end-to-end — intake through resolution — coordinating across teams and serving as the operational lead alongside the account manager. You'll also capture structured data on each event so patterns surface to leadership over time.
* **Contract-to-Billing:** Own the data and reconciliation work that keeps ARR and billing accurate across systems: contract data entry, tracking go-live dates, syncing billing updates, and catching discrepancies before they compound into reporting problems. Attend the weekly revenue meeting as an operational resource who can help resolve issues in real time, not just report on status.
* **Change Orders & Pilots:** Own the intake and tracking of contract amendments and expansions through to resolution. Manage pilot operations — milestone monitoring, flagging stalls, and driving decisions before delays cost billing revenue.
* **Post-Close Coordination**: Own the handoff from signed contract to implementation and customer success. Track what needs to happen after close and make sure it does.
* **Automation & Process Design:** Identify the manual, repetitive coordination work in this function and systematically eliminate it. Design and deploy automated monitoring for open milestones, billing dates, and discrepancies. Build workflows and AI-powered tools that let you operate proactively rather than reactively.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

***Required***

* 3–6 years in an operations role with real ownership — Revenue Operations, CS Operations, Implementation, or Commercial Operations in B2B SaaS or healthcare tech
* Demonstrated ability to run complex, cross-functional processes end-to-end and be accountable for outcomes, not just inputs
