* Comfort operating across Sales, Finance, CS, and Implementation simultaneously — moving things forward without a manager brokering every conversation
* Experience in senior living, multi-site healthcare, or a comparably complex B2B environment is a meaningful advantage

***How You Work***

* You see broken processes as problems to fix, not facts to work around — your instinct is root cause, not workaround
* You're genuinely interested in AI and automation and have used these tools to make your own work faster; you're ready to build with them systematically, not just use them ad hoc
* You bring composure to difficult or sensitive situations — including customer-facing conversations in the middle of a stressful transition or decommission
* You communicate proactively and clearly across functions, surfacing issues before they become someone else's emergency
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and can prioritize across competing demands without needing everything defined upfront

**Salary Range:** *$140,000 - $160,000 USD commensurate with experience*

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Executive Scope
new_jobs.description:
**R3VOLUTION AD SERVICES, INC.**

Project Manager (Executive Scope) — Client Acquisition, Government Contracts, Team Leadership

R3volution AD Services, Inc. — Houston, Texas | Full-time | 100% Remote | $65,000 base + 3% commission + bonuses

New Orleans Soul. Texas Backbone. Marketing Done Right.

This seat is the right hand to the Founder & Head CEO. It exists for one reason: bring in regional and government accounts, and keep them. Everything else — systems, team, build schedule — is the machine revenue runs through, and you run the machine. The title is Project Manager; the work is executive, with a path to Operations Manager and Chief Operating Officer.

Read the whole post. The application is a test, and the instructions are not all in one place.

Step One Is a Video. No Video, No Application.

Record one Loom (loom.com, free account) in six parts, in this order. The free plan gives you five minutes; the parts add up to exactly 5:00. Hitting the mark is your first test of delivering under a hard limit.

Part 1 — The Open (0:15, camera on). Face visible. State your full name, your city and country, your committed Houston (US Central) overlap hours, and say the application code word from the bottom of this post out loud. No code word in the first 15 seconds and we stop watching there.

Part 2 — The Pitch (1:15, camera on, one take, no script). You are on a discovery call with the Director of Marketing at a 200-employee regional healthcare group. Sell R3volution AD Services. We are listening for how you open, whether you sell an outcome, and whether you ask for a next step.

Part 3 — The Pipeline (1:30, screen share). Open a CRM, pipeline or project board you personally ran (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Zoho, Salesforce, ClickUp, Google Sheets). Walk one real account from first contact to close: the stages, how follow-up was tracked, where it stalled, what you did to unstick it. Blur the client if you must; we are judging the structure, not the logo. No CRM to show? Open whatever you actually used — a spreadsheet, a board, a doc — and walk the same account. If you never tracked a pipeline anywhere, that is the answer we are listening for.

Part 4 — Something You Built (1:00, screen share). Open the inside of one thing you built yourself: a live Zap with filters or paths, a ManyChat flow, an SOP, a dashboard. Walk the logic. Then tell us one thing that broke in it and exactly how you fixed it. "I used the tool" and "I built the tool" look different within ten seconds.

Part 5 — The Pressure Test (0:45, camera on, unscripted). Answer cold, no slides: "A retained client is six weeks into a campaign, the numbers are flat, and they email saying they want to cancel. You have that call in one hour. What do you open with, and what do you ask for before you hang up?"

Part 6 — The Setup Check (0:15, screen share). Share your screen, open speedtest.net or fast.com, press Go, and let the result appear on camera. Then say your backup internet plan and your backup power plan, one sentence each.

Rules: total runtime 5:00 — not 4:10, not 5:40. One continuous take per part: no cuts, slides, script, AI voice or avatar. English throughout. Link must open without a login.

Who We Are

R3volution AD Services, Inc. is a Houston, Texas digital marketing, AI platform development and government contracting firm, operating since 2017. We build custom AI-powered systems — including our own CRM and AI voice-calling platform — for healthcare, legal, manufacturing and public-sector clients, run three proprietary AI platforms (FundedAIPro, PromoFlowAI, InfiniteCMO), and work an active government pipeline. You report directly to the Founder & Head CEO.

The One Thing That Matters Most

This seat exists to bring in clients and keep them. If you run beautiful operations and the client list does not grow, you have failed the role.

Think like an owner, run it like a project manager. You will be managing projects, but the standard is an owner's: every dollar, every day lost, every client call and every slipped date is yours as if the company were yours. We are growing — new markets, new platforms, more government work — and we are hiring the person who has done this before and intends to be here at year 3, 10 and 30.

The target is regional and above: regional healthcare groups, multi-office law firms, mid-market and enterprise manufacturers, multi-state B2B operators. Local accounts are fine but not what this seat is measured on. Government — municipal, county, state, federal — is a priority lane. Then you keep them. Churn on an account you closed is your number.

The 90-day clock. Your application includes a 90-day client acquisition plan (it is in the 15 application questions). If no account is closed inside your first 90 days, we treat that as a clear signal this seat is not the right fit, and we act on it.

The Six Mandates

Mandate One — Revenue. Get clients. Keep clients. Your standing first priority, every day.

* Build the target account list: named companies, named decision-makers, verified contact data, tiered by value. Run outbound Monday through Saturday — LinkedIn, email, calls, referral and partner channels. Pick the niche you can win in and stay in it until it pays.

* Qualify every inbound inquiry and warm reply within 4 business hours.

* Sit in client meetings with the CEO, then run discovery calls yourself once you have earned it. Speaking of which: the first words out of your mouth in Part 2 of your Loom, before you pitch a single thing, are the dollar value of the largest contract you have ever personally closed. Say the number. Then sell. A closer who cannot say their number out loud has not got one.

* You close. Proposals, scopes and pricing packets are yours to produce; the contract is yours to bring across the line. Once you have proven it, you build and train a sales team to close the same way.

* Government lane: watch SAM.gov and state, county and city portals; keep a live bid calendar; deliver

The Project Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and execution of temporary tent structures, scaffolding systems, and related event infrastructure. This role oversees projects from initial planning and site assessment through installation, event operations, dismantling, and post-project review.

The Project Manager works closely with clients, sales teams, operations, engineers, vendors, crew leads, and field staff to ensure that temporary structures are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and in accordance with project requirements, site conditions, manufacturer specifications, and applicable safety standards. This a National role and does not need to be located in one of our offices. Travel will be required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage tent structure, scaffolding, and temporary infrastructure projects from planning through completion.
* Review project requirements, site plans, drawings, layouts, specifications, and installation schedules.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Clients, vendors, engineers, and field crews to establish project scope, requirements, and expectations.
* Conduct or coordinate site assessments to identify access limitations, ground conditions, utilities, overhead obstructions, staging areas, and other potential installation challenges.
* Develop project timelines, installation schedules, dismantling plans, equipment requirements, and crew requirements.
* Coordinate tent structure and scaffolding equipment, components, hardware, ballast, rigging, flooring, lighting, and other required materials.
* Work with asset and logistics teams to develop accurate load lists and coordinate transportation to and from job sites.
* Coordinate delivery, staging, installation, inspection, modification, and dismantling of temporary structures.
* Work closely with crew leads to ensure structures are installed efficiently and according to approved plans and procedures.
* Monitor project progress and make adjustments to labor, equipment, schedules, and logistics as required.
* Job Costing – coordinating with Sales & Operations and Management to review project estimates, change orders and additional labor or equipment impacting job cost.
* Identify potential structural, safety, logistical, or operational issues before and during installation and implement appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate with engineering or qualified technical personnel when site conditions or project requirements require structural review or engineering input.
* Ensure work is performed in accordance with applicable safety requirements, manufacturer specifications, approved plans, and company procedures.
* Maintain a strong focus on fall protection, site safety, lifting operations, equipment handling, and safe work practices.
* Conduct or coordinate pre-installation and post-installation inspections as required.
* Verify that completed structures meet project requirements and maintain a professional, high-quality presentation.
* Coordinate setup and takedown activities to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently, and within established timelines.
* Communicate project changes, scope changes, site conditions, additional labor, equipment requirements, and potential cost impacts to Sales and management promptly.
* Provide End-of-Day Reports, project updates, and post-event After Action Reports.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, equipment, structures, or enhancements that may benefit the client.
* Provide constructive feedback and practical solutions for challenges encountered in the field.

new_jobs.title: Patient Engagement Specialist (CareSync Coordinator)
new_jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

**Department:** Patient Support Center – CareSync

**Position Type:** Full-Time | Remote | Hourly, Non-Exempt

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 7 AM–6:00 PM CT; flexibility to support new patient inbound coverage as needed.

**Who We Are**

Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.

**The Role**

The **Patient Engagement Specialist** is a high-impact, outbound-first role at the heart of patient access and acquisition. You are the voice that reaches out to patients after they’ve been referred or expressed interest in care, helping them move from referral to a scheduled first visit. You’ll process incoming referrals, make timely and persistent outreach, and deliver white-glove support to the referring providers who trust us with their patients. You’ll also flex to answer new patient inbound calls when volume calls for it.

This is a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment for people who care deeply about both outcomes and experience. You’ll use strong virtual human connection, sound judgment, and follow-through to remove barriers to care, connect each patient to the right provider, and keep referring partners informed every step of the way. If you bring empathy, urgency, and a growth mindset, and believe every outreach is an opportunity to help someone take the next step, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

**Drive Outbound Engagement & Conversion**

* Proactively call referred patients and new patient leads, making first contact the same or next business day and following a structured outreach cadence until the patient is scheduled or the referral is closed.
* Convert referrals and leads into scheduled first visits by matching each patient to the right provider using screening questions, insurance, provider preferences, and scheduling tools.
* Guide hesitant patients toward a confident “yes” using empathy, reflective listening, communication frameworks, and sound judgment while removing barriers without pressure.
* Set clear expectations for the first visit so patients arrive informed, comfortable, and ready to attend.
* Meet individual and team targets for speed to first outreach, contact rate, and referral-to-scheduled conversion.

**Process Referrals Accurately**

* Receive, review, and process incoming referrals from email, fax, phone, and partner channels promptly and accurately.
* Confirm patient demographic and insurance information is complete and accurate; follow up with the referring office or patient to close any gaps.
* Track each referral from receipt to first visit so status is clear to referring partners and internal teams.
* Build and maintain working knowledge of accepted insurance plans.

**Deliver White-Glove Support to Referring Providers**

* Serve as a responsive, reliable point of contact for referring provider offices, answering questions and sharing timely referral status updates.
* Close the loop with referring providers by confirming receipt, sharing scheduling outcomes, and letting them know when another level of care may be a better fit.
* Build trusted relationships with key partner practices so Geode is an easy, dependable place to send their patients.

**Flex to Support New Patient Inbound Calls**

* Answer new patient inbound calls during peak volume or as assigned, with warmth, urgency, and a bias toward booking the first visit.
* Partner with the Patient Support Center team to keep handoffs seamless for patients and providers.

**Grow Through Coaching & Quality**

* Work toward individual and team goals for conversion, outreach timeliness, contact rate, quality, and documentation, using feedback and performance insights to keep improving.
* Welcome regular call auditing and coaching as fuel for growth; apply feedback quickly and consistently.
* Document every outreach attempt and interaction accurately in our systems with the right context and a clear next step.

**Own the Patient & Provider Experience**

* Create a calm, personalized experience that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.
* Protect patient privacy by maintaining strict confidentiality and following HIPAA and all privacy requirements.
* Flex with changing workflows, volumes, and schedules while supporting the broader team as needs shift.

**Who You Are**

* A hospitality-minded people person - you make others feel genuinely cared for and you love creating great experiences.
* Energized by outbound outreach - comfortable making proactive calls and following up with persistence and care.
* Motivated by goals and comfortable using feedback and performance insights to improve.
* A persuasive, empathetic communicator who can navigate emotional or complex conversations with calm and confidence.
* Organized and process-oriented - you track details closely and keep every referral moving.
* Coachable and self-aware - you welcome feedback, know your strengths, and actively develop your areas of opportunity.
* Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

**What You Bring**

* 1–3+ years in a customer-facing, phone-based, or hospitality role; experience in a medical office, mental health, referral coordination, outbound calling, or sales/conversion is a strong plus.
* Comfort working in a goal-oriented, quality-focused environment.
* Familiarity with insurance plans and benefits, or the ability to learn them quickl

The successful candidate will combine practical proposal experience with exceptional organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. * Coordinate professionals across multiple functions and organizational levels, maintaining productive working relationships and accountability without formal supervisory authority.
* Manage multiple concurrent proposal activities, balancing competing priorities and submission deadlines.

=====================

  
National OnDemand, Inc. is a company dedicated to providing OnDemand services Nationally, Anytime, Anywhere! Through the completion of multiple mergers, acquisitions and organic growth the company is continuing to grow rapidly across the country. There are 6 primary divisions of the company: Fiber Services, Construction Services, Structured Cabling Services, Home Services, Business Services, and Emergency Services. The various divisions of the company allow National OnDemand to provide full turnkey solutions to all customers.  
  
The Splicing Program Manager is responsible for the planning, staffing, production, quality, and financial performance of fiber splicing operations across an assigned region. The role leads the Fiber Splicing Managers in that region and is accountable for splicing production, test and documentation quality, crew utilization, and client deliverables across all active projects.  
  

**Primary Position Duties:**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Fiber Splicing Managers across the region. Set production, quality, and safety expectations and review performance against them.

* Review client statements of work, splice matrices, and specifications during pre-construction and confirm splicing scope, unit pricing, test requirements, and documentation deliverables before work starts.
* Establish and enforce regional splicing standards for workmanship, OTDR and power meter testing, loss budgets, labeling, and closeout documentation in line with client specifications and industry standards.
* Track weekly splicing production, earned value, and backlog across all regional projects and report status, risks, and recovery plans to the Director of Operations and the Project Management team.
* Partner with Project Managers and Construction Managers on splicing schedules, resource conflicts, and sequencing with construction crews.
* Own splicing billing accuracy. Verify that daily work reports, redlines, and test results support invoiced units and resolve coding and quantity disputes with the client and the PMO.

* Conduct site safety audits, lead incident and near miss investigations, complete root cause and corrective actions, and report findings to the Director of Operations and Safety.
* Track regional safety metrics (recordables, vehicle incidents, near misses, audit scores) and hold Fiber Splicing Managers accountable for results.
* Support bids and new market startups with splicing production rates, crew plans, and cost inputs.
* Own the regional splicing training program. Define the skills matrix and certification path for splicers from entry level through lead splicer and Fiber Splicing Manager, and track each employee against it.

* Develop apprentice and entry level splicing pathways with in house trainers and partner programs to expand capacity without relying solely on subcontract labor.
* Travel to project sites to audit quality, production, and safety.

==========================

* 8 years or more of fiber splicing and testing experience in outside plant construction, including 3 years or more managing splicing managers, foremen, or multiple crews across more than one project.
* Expert knowledge of fusion and mechanical splicing, splice enclosure and cabinet work, OTDR and OLTS testing, and interpretation of test results against client loss budgets.
* Working knowledge of FTTH and PON architectures, backbone and long haul fiber, and splice matrix and as built documentation.
* Experience managing subcontractor crews, including rate negotiation, onboarding, and performance management.
* Experience with production tracking, unit based billing, and field reporting platforms (PenguinData, Render, or similar) and Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook).
* Understanding of project budgets, unit costs, and crew utilization and the ability to manage splicing operations to margin.

* Demonstrated experience building and delivering technical training programs and developing field technicians into supervisors.

* Must be able to work nights and weekends, if necessary.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Consultant, Systems Integration Enablement
new_jobs.description:
**YOUR MISSION**

The Senior Consultant, Integrations Enablement is responsible for building the capabilities, processes, and cross-functional alignment required for successful integration delivery across Nulogy’s partner ecosystem. This role ensures implementation partners and customers are equipped to deliver high-quality integration outcomes that drive customer satisfaction and long-term value.

In addition, this leader will identify and remove operational barriers, optimize Customer Lifecycle (CLC) processes, and strengthen collaboration between partners and internal teams to create a scalable and efficient integration delivery model.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as an escalation point for complex integration delivery challenges, partnering with customers, implementation partners, and internal stakeholders to drive successful outcomes and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Foster strong cross-functional relationships across Nulogy and its partner ecosystem, proactively identifying and resolving organizational barriers that impact integration delivery and customer success.
* Partner with Professional Services leadership to develop resource strategies and capacity plans that support scalable integration delivery across customers and implementation partners.
* Drive the evolution of processes, tools, and operating models that enable partners and internal teams to deliver integrations efficiently, consistently, and at scale.
* Ensure implementation partners and customers are appropriately supported during solution discovery and integration planning activities, enabling accurate scoping and successful delivery outcomes.
* Build and maintain the frameworks, documentation, training, and best practices required to enable successful integration delivery by partners and customers.
* Champion operational excellence by identifying opportunities to improve integration delivery efficiency, quality, predictability, and customer experience throughout the Customer Lifecycle (CLC).
* Partner with Finance and other internal stakeholders to ensure alignment and transparency regarding project changes, commercial impacts, and customer commitments.
* Provide leadership and guidance on managing changes to integration scope, solution design, timelines, and delivery plans to minimize risk and maintain customer success.
* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen Nulogy’s integration capabilities, partner ecosystem, and overall scalability.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team through regular feedback, career development planning, performance management, and mentorship.
* Build a model to help partners recruit, hire, and onboard top talent to support the growth and maturity of the integrations function within their organization.
* Lead the implementation of Nulogy’s most complex integration projects
* Partner with product management to continually improve our suite of integration technologies
* Provide documentation and reference material to enable our Global Support team

**EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS**

* Work well in small teams and are a good team player
* Enjoy fast paced environments with competing deadlines
* Friendly, empathetic, patient, and personable even under stressful circumstances
* Organized and hardworking
* Eager to build lasting relationships with our customers and their employees
* Able to be persuasive and manage customer expectations
* Possess outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrate a strong ability to solve problems creatively, and systematically
* Demonstrate great attention to detail, and be an organized thinker
* Deftly and diplomatically navigate complex interpersonal dynamics

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**  
  
Nulogy is a manufacturing technology company driven by a vision to make life better for the people who plan, produce, and deliver the products we use every day.  
Nulogy’s Manufacturing Operating System helps manufacturers and packagers automate every stage of the production process—from inventory to quality—which reduces operating costs, increases efficiency, and boosts customer satisfaction. Hundreds of manufacturing sites around the world are powered by Nulogy, and our software also runs in the networks of world-leading brands such as Colgate-Palmolive, L’Oréal, and Procter & Gamble.  
  
Nulogy has grown rapidly over the last decade, and we are proud to be recognized with a number of awards including: Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers, Food Logistics Top 100 Software Provider, and Canada's Most Admired Corporate Culture. Nulogy has also received multiple awards for company culture, the most recent being one of Canada’s Top Small & Medium Employers for 2024, Great Place to Work 2025 & Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2025.  
  
By joining Nulogy, you’ll become part of a fantastic culture of capable and motivated individuals. You’ll also join a team that is solving challenging problems every day with the potential to make a global impact.  
  
**OUR VALUES**  
**1. We put people first**  
We lead with genuine care, build strong relationships, and create space for people to grow.  
**2. We rewrite the playbook**  
We don’t wait for perfect conditions. We move, deliver, and refine, solving problems creatively as we go.  
**3. We learn up**  
We stay curious, learn from the people and experiences around us, and keep looking ahead.  
**4. We take the hot potato!**  
When something goes wrong, we don’t pass the problem along. We take ownership and work together to solve it.  
**5. We ring the bell together**  
We celebrate success as a team and recognize the people who helped make it happen.  
  
**WHY NULOGY**  
We’re solving problems that no one has been able to solve before. This is an opportunity to join a team that is transforming the way that supply chains are structured.
